jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

What this job involves:

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of capital improvement projects for a dedicated client account, overseeing day-to-day activities across programming, planning, design, construction, and project closeout. This role manages multiple small-duration, lower-cost projects simultaneously while ensuring delivery within budget, on schedule, and aligned with client objectives and JLL governance standards. Acting as the primary liaison between clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders, the Project Manager brings a collaborative and solutions-focused approach to every stage of the project lifecycle. This account recently negotiated a new, five year MSA that just started.

At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way — for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees — and this role plays an important part in delivering spaces and experiences that support business success. What sets JLL apart is our culture of collaboration, locally and across the globe, and this position partners closely with cross-functional teams to drive operational excellence, manage risk, and deliver a high standard of client service.

What your day-to-day will look like:

Develop and manage project-specific goals, schedules, budgets, and execution strategies to support successful project delivery.
Establish project success criteria and ensure alignment with both client expectations and JLL standards.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle, maintaining strong relationships and clear communication.
Guide stakeholders through the design and implementation process, including conceptual planning, design development, construction documentation, and approvals.
Create and maintain detailed project schedules, monitor milestones and critical path activities, and proactively manage project risks and dependencies.
Coordinate due diligence activities and ensure all required project documentation is complete, accurate, and delivered on time.
Prepare and manage RFP processes for contractors and vendors, including bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract coordination.
Oversee vendor, contractor, and project team performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and client expectations.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support the refinement of best practices and standards of excellence across JLL.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, architecture, engineering, real estate, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 3 - 5 years of experience in corporate real estate, project management, or construction management environments.
Practical experience working with ADA requirements and construction-related compliance standards.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines, budgets, and quality expectations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with executive-level stakeholders and project teams.
Excellent organizational and analytical skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience managing capital improvement projects within corporate, commercial real estate, or occupied office environments.
Familiarity with project management tools, scheduling software, and financial reporting processes.
Understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and project cost control methodologies.
Experience coordinating with external consultants, contractors, and jurisdictional agencies.
Strong client relationship management skills with a focus on delivering exceptional customer service.
Ability to identify project risks proactively and implement mitigation strategies effectively.
Experience contributing to process improvement initiatives and operational best practices.
We believe the most effective teams are built when everyone is empowered to thrive, and candidates who bring a collaborative mindset and commitment to inclusivity will excel in this role.

Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited about helping drive production onboarding, usage, and adoption.
Experience communicating and working across functions to proactively drive solutions.
Eager to learn about the insurance claims industry and positively impact the people involved.
Exceptionally organized with the ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously
You excel in working across technical and non-technical teams, using clear, effective communication to ensure alignment and resolve any roadblocks
You have a solid technical background and can quickly understand complex product configurations, streamline onboarding processes, and create clear documentation
You keep the customer experience top of mind, focusing on enhancing satisfaction and operational efficiency through thoughtful planning and execution

Own and drive end-to-end projects, managing timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
Own and drive agile adoption and best practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and data driven decision making.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand technical requirements and validate projects and integrations (e.g., RESTful APIs, cloud environments, data migrations).

Proactively identify and resolve blockers, aligning cross-functional priorities and ensuring project momentum.
Maintain a customer-first mindset, ensuring integrations deliver operational value and enhance user experience.
Thrive in a fast-moving environment, adapting to change while driving clarity, structure, and accountability.

Requirements

Proven experience with a technical onboarding process for SaaS Platforms.
Proficiency in creating documentation and integration guides tailored to technical and non-technical audiences

Strong leadership skills to ensure team accountability and maintain project momentum.
A passion for building intuitive technology and a thirst for learning.
Able to think through customer requirements and prioritize what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant.
Have a strong technical skillset but also the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency.

401(k) retirement plan with employer matching

Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work

Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

The role spans planning frameworks, cross-functional governance, tooling, and a bias toward getting things done over documenting process.

We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable in a leadership meeting setting direction and in the weeds resolving a dependency. The ideal candidate has deep experience running complex programs in SaaS environments, understands how modern product and engineering organizations work, and knows how to build alignment and move work forward fast across a distributed company.

Own strategic programs from initiation through delivery and adoption, maintaining clarity on goals, scope, and status at every stage.
Create visibility and alignment across leadership by translating complex program activity into clear, decision-ready reporting.
Track deadlines, deliverables, resources, and action items with rigor, and hold owners accountable for their commitments.
Identify cross-team dependencies and risks early, and make sure they are visible, owned, and mitigated before they become blockers.

Process and Governance

Design, refine, and roll out planning and governance processes that help a distributed product organization move faster and more consistently.
Define and track KPIs that give leadership a clear picture of engineering effectiveness, delivery health, and team capacity.

Facilitate retrospectives and lessons-learned sessions that actually result in changes, not just documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Product, Engineering, CloudOps, and Support & Services to streamline delivery and reduce friction at the hand-off points.

Lead change efforts that connect directly to business outcomes - faster delivery, reduced rework, better predictability.

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager with working knowledge of the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) framework to manage all actions associated with a United States Federal CMMC audit for a strategic, enterprise customer. This Project Manager will bring familiarity with CMMC assessment processes, evidence requirements, and audit lifecycle stages, and will work closely with the customer and internal Cyderes colleagues to ensure all audit requirements are delivered on time, within scope, and to a high standard of quality. This individual will be accountable for attending all audit sessions, applying their understanding of CMMC assessment expectations to help ensure a successful outcome for everything Cyderes is required to support.

Own end-to-end delivery of CMMC audit deliverables, applying knowledge of CMMC domains, practices, and assessment objectives to ensure all audit follow-up questions are answered accurately by the appropriate Cyderes team member(s)
Develop and maintain planning documents, timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, and delivery schedules aligned to CMMC assessment phases and evidence-collection requirements
Manage resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests as encountered throughout the audit process, drawing on familiarity with common CMMC audit pitfalls and assessor expectations
Serve as the primary project-management contact for the customer on Cyderes' CMMC audit deliverables and overall support, able to speak knowledgeably to CMMC scoping, controls, and evidence standards
Participate in all meetings, recurring status sessions, and executive updates related to the CMMC audit activity, translating CMMC-specific requirements into clear project status and risk narratives for stakeholders
Coordinate cross-functional Cyderes teams — including cybersecurity consultants and engineers — to ensure CMMC evidence (SSPs, POA&Ms, artifacts, control mappings, etc.) is complete, accurate, and provided on time
Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers tied to CMMC audit requirements and drive timely resolution and escalation of Cyderes-related actions
Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards, customer expectations, and CMMC assessment criteria for everything Cyderes is accountable for providing
Lead project closeout, lessons learned, documentation, and transition activities, capturing insights to strengthen future CMMC engagements

Requirements

Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered
5+ years of project management experience, preferably within cybersecurity, IT, consulting, or professional services
Working knowledge of the CMMC framework, including its maturity levels, control domains, and assessment/audit process, gained through direct project involvement, training, or certification
Prior experience supporting or coordinating a CMMC assessment, audit, or readiness effort — as a PM, coordinator, or adjacent role — strongly preferred
Proven experience managing complex, customer-facing technology projects from initiation through completion
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, priorities, and cross-functional teams
Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, schedule, resources, risks, and dependencies in a compliance or audit-driven environment
Excellent customer-facing communication, presentation, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate technical CMMC requirements for non-technical stakeholders

The Purchasing Partner owns a portfolio of User Experience (UX) Research vendor engagements end to end, from intake through agreement execution and invoicing.
This is an ownership role, not a support role. You are accountable for the momentum of every case in your queue: driving requests across the finish line, following up with stakeholders and securing the approvals needed to close them, resolving blockers that sit outside your direct control, and proactively reporting status to your manager and stakeholders before anyone asks.

Project Manager I
Minimum Qualifications:

4 years of experience in project coordination, project or program management, procurement, vendor management, or operations, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of an assigned workstream.
Self-starter with demonstrated ability to drive multiple cases to completion simultaneously across cross-functional teams and external partners in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities, maintaining visibility into every engagement, following up persistently, escalating when needed, and closing every loop.
Demonstrated ability to manage momentum across a portfolio of active projects with minimal day-to-day supervision, keeping every case advancing and creating urgency for others when the next action sits with someone else.

Demonstrated ability to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to increase personal productivity and scale coverage, identifying where they add value and maintaining ownership of output quality.
Ability to communicate quickly and clearly with peers, cross-functional stakeholders, and senior management, adapting communication style to the audience.

Track record of being detail-oriented and organized while managing a high volume of work.

Own a portfolio of User Experience Research (UXR) vendor engagements end to end, from intake through Statement of Work (SOW) creation and execution, Purchase Order (PO) issuance, and invoicing, and drive each case to completion.

Bachelor's degree in health sciences, engineering, business administration or related field or equivalent years of related experience

Understanding of healthcare IT systems and data

Experience with project management and facilitating change management

Exceptional communication, organizational and stakeholder management skills

Master's degree in business or healthcare field

Background in perioperative services, including knowledge of surgical workflows

Intermediate JavaScript skills

EMR integration experience (e.g. HL7, FHIR, Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth)

Healthcare software customization experience

Experience with Pendo Guide, ZenDesk 

Project management certification

Healthcare IT implementation experience

Intellectual and emotional satisfaction of solving tough operational problems in healthcare while improving patient access and saving lives!

Competitive compensation package that includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options

Comprehensive healthcare benefits

Job Description

WSP is seeking a Power & Energy Project Manager
for our Power & Energy Program Management Office in New York, NY. The following locations will also be considered: Freeport, ME; Dallas, TX; Houston, TX; Fort Wayne, IN; Oakland, CA; Fayetteville, AR; Tulsa, OK; Columbus, OH; Vancouver, WA; Portland, OR and Omaha, NE
. The successful candidate may work remotely from a mutually acceptable location within the United States and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings.

This Opportunity

This position provides high level technical project leadership, and guidance with managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of EHV Transmission and Substation project(s) or portfolio of projects in accordance with WSP’s core values, and the level of project services agreed upon in the contract by WSP and the client(s). Responsible for the overall performance of assigned project(s) that are moderate and larger size/complexity and regional in scope, and includes oversight for financial, technical, client satisfaction, quality, safety, and schedule. Ensures that responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, project startup and planning, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable corporate standards for safety, execution, profitability, and operational purpose.

Your Impact

Coordinate and communicate with all levels of management and disciplines throughout the project life cycle to support project cost and schedule objectives, both internally and within the client’s systems.
Lead the development of project proposals, cost estimates, scope, schedules, and resource plans
Oversee management of budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, cost and change management and control.
Provide regular project reporting and updates to clients, technical leads, and business leaders, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget and mitigation strategies.
Be the face of WSP for the client. Develop and nurture strong, long-term relationships with client by understanding their needs, providing tailored solutions, and ensuring consistent communication to drive satisfaction and retention.
Adherence to proven processes and ability to develop new processes to standardize procedures.
Adhere to safety regulations and enforce project safety standards
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, Project Management or Construction Management), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C firm, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
10+ years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within our industry.
Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process and strong background and experience in project management. Experience managing projects through a variety of delivery models (DBB, EPC, PDB).
Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. jobs.title: Privacy Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

Legal and Compliance manages all legal and regulatory matters, including privacy, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, employment law, intellectual property, government relations, and claims, while supporting Coursera's and Udemy's platforms and partnerships. The Privacy Program Manager is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the company's global privacy program across products, platforms, and business functions. Working closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, this role translates privacy and data protection requirements into scalable operational processes, governance, and technical controls that embed privacy by design across the organization. The role owns core privacy operations, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, vendor privacy reviews, and data subject rights requests, while driving automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement to enable the business to meet privacy obligations efficiently at scale.

Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Procurement, and other stakeholders to conduct privacy reviews for new products, features, vendors, and business initiatives, embedding privacy by design into business processes.
Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.

Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

Position Summary

The Senior Talent Acquisition Program Manager drives strategic hiring initiatives that strengthen Empower’s ability to attract exceptional talent within a hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A and 503B environment. This role owns end-to-end execution of enterprise Talent Acquisition programs, including Early Careers, Always-On Pipelining, Competitive Hiring, and strategic initiatives, ensuring projects remain aligned, visible, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is measured through operational and program-delivery metrics—milestone adherence, execution quality, and stakeholder satisfaction—rather than recruiting-volume metrics. Leveraging AI as a force multiplier, the position accelerates planning, reporting, decision-making, knowledge management, and operational efficiency while maintaining quality, compliance, and candidate experience. Success requires Talent Acquisition expertise, disciplined project management, exceptional stakeholder partnership, and continuous improvement. This opportunity is designed for P80–P90 talent demonstrating strategic thinking, execution rigor, learning agility, and unwavering accountability for delivering scalable recruiting programs that create sustainable organizational impact.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership

Program Ownership: Own end-to-end planning and execution of strategic Talent Acquisition programs, such as early careers, proactive pipelining, competitive intelligence, and other prioritized initiatives. Develop comprehensive project plans, manage milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables while leveraging AI-enabled planning, documentation, and reporting tools to improve execution speed, stakeholder visibility, decision quality, and overall program performance across multiple concurrent workstreams supporting business growth.
Strategic Execution: Translate Talent Acquisition priorities into structured project roadmaps by defining objectives, timelines, success metrics, governance, and resource requirements. Balance competing priorities while proactively identifying risks, resolving issues, and utilizing AI-generated insights to strengthen planning accuracy, optimize resource allocation, improve execution consistency, and ensure projects deliver measurable business value aligned with organizational objectives and hiring strategies.
Risk Management: Establish disciplined project governance by monitoring progress, identifying emerging risks, escalating issues appropriately, and implementing mitigation strategies before challenges impact hiring outcomes. Utilize AI-assisted reporting, predictive analysis, and operational dashboards to improve visibility, support informed decision-making, strengthen accountability, and ensure strategic Talent Acquisition programs remain on schedule, within scope, and positioned for long-term success.

Talent Acquisition Expertise

Recruiting Partnership: Partner closely with recruiters, sourcers, Talent Acquisition leaders, and hiring managers to translate recruiting strategies into executable project plans that improve hiring outcomes. Apply practical expertise in sourcing, funnel management, candidate experience, employer branding, and workforce planning while leveraging AI tools to enhance planning, collaboration, documentation, and operational effectiveness without replacing sound recruiting judgment.
Pipeline Strategy: Support strategic hiring programs by understanding the unique objectives, timelines, and success measures associated with campus recruiting, evergreen talent pipelines, and competitive hiring initiatives. Monitor funnel health, identify substantive recruiting risks beyond project schedules, leverage AI-driven insights to recognize trends, and recommend corrective actions that strengthen pipeline quality and hiring effectiveness.
Program Excellence: Develop repeatable operating models, implementation plans, and recruiting playbooks that enable Talent Acquisition programs to scale consistently across business functions. Capture lessons learned, standardize best practices, and use AI-supported knowledge management to improve documentation quality, accelerate onboarding, preserve institutional knowledge, and continuously enhance execution across future hiring initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the central point of coordination across Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, Marketing, business leaders, universities, vendors, and external partners to maintain alignment, resolve dependencies, and ensure seamless execution. Facilitate productive discussions using structured communication, AI-assisted meeting preparation, and transparent reporting that builds trust, strengthens collaboration, and drives successful project outcomes.
Executive Communication: Deliver concise, data-driven updates that provide leaders with clear visibility into project health, hiring progress, program risks, and recommended actions. Develop executive-ready dashboards, presentations, and status reports enhanced through AI-generated analysis while ensuring messaging remains accurate, actionable, compliant, and aligned with organizational priorities and strategic workforce objectives.
Event Coordination: Coordinate recruiting events, career fairs, campus engagement activities, hiring campaigns, and cross-functional initiatives that strengthen employer branding and talent attraction efforts. Manage logistics, communications, stakeholder readiness, and execution plans while utilizing AI to streamline planning activities, improve scheduling efficiency, enhance candidate experiences, and maximize program effectiveness throughout each recruiting cycle.

Operational Excellence

Performance Analytics: Measure and communicate program effectiveness through meaningful recruiting metrics, dashboards, and business insights including pipeline health, conversion rates, hiring velocity, and program outcomes. Leverage AI-powered analytics to identify trends, forecast opportunities, uncover operational improvement areas, and equip leaders with actionable recommendations that strengthen recruiting performance and strategic decision-making.
Process Improvement: Evaluate Talent Acquisition workflows to identify inefficiencies, eliminate unnecessary complexity, standardize operating procedures, and improve execution quality across recruiting programs. Apply structured continuous improvement methodologies supported by AI-enabled workflow analysis to enhance scalability, reduce manual effort, improve stakeholder experiences, and create sustainable operational excellence supporting organizational growth.
Vendor Evaluation: Support periodic evaluation and selection of Talent Acquisition vendors, tools, and platforms as program needs evolve, preparing recommendations for leadership review; this role does not hold budget ownership, and hands-on guidance for vendor analysis and selection will be provided as needed.
Continuous Learning: Maintain awareness of emerging Talent Acquisition practices, project management methodologies, AI capabilities, and industry trends that strengthen organizational performance. Champion innovation through thoughtful experimentation, continuous learning, and disciplined implementation while balancing business agility with governance, compliance, and long-term operational sustainability in a rapidly evolving hiring environment.

Knowledge And Skills

Demonstrated knowledge of Talent Acquisition operations, including recruiting lifecycle management, sourcing strategies, pipeline development, candidate experience, hiring metrics, workforce planning, and recruiting program execution.
Strong project management capabilities with experience developing project plans, managing timelines, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, mitigating risks, and delivering complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

Job Description

The Role:

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high-intensity, high-visibility execution role involving the creation of net-new data-driven, AI- and ML-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.

The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.

This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations.

What You’ll Be Doing In This Role

Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect & adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas
Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement
Leading end-to-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform-specific workflows
Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor
Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization
Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream
Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year-on-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures

What You Bring

5-8 years of project management experience
Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard
A self-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told
Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal
Experience in technology-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution
Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools
Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities to improve team productivity and decision-making
Strong RAID discipline, schedule management, budget oversight, and the instinct to track details without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Comfortable managing multiple workstreams concurrently in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus
North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.

This position has a starting salary range of $75,000 – $90,000 USD / 75,000 – 123,000 CAD
per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

Lead the rollout of CMMC and FedRAMP program readiness strategies and implementation plans.
Act as the central coordinator between IT, legal, sourcing, and executive leadership across both the CMMC and FedRAMP programs.

Establish program scorecards, executive dashboards, and risk management tracking for compliance metrics.

Experience with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tools.

Description

Leidos
is seeking an experienced and dynamic Program Manager
to lead the establishment and growth of a development and integration center in Pune, India
. This role will be responsible for standing up the center, partnering closely with end-user customers and stakeholders, and overseeing day-to-day operations to build and sustain a high-performing technical team.

The Program Manager
will drive the delivery of system enhancements while advancing the systems engineering and integration capabilities of the SkyLine-X
product suite. SkyLine-X™ is Leidos’ next-generation Air Traffic Management (ATM)
platform, designed to help air navigation service providers safely and efficiently manage increasingly complex airspace. Built on decades of Leidos aviation and air traffic management experience, SkyLine-X provides a modern, scalable platform supporting critical capabilities across tower, terminal, en-route, oceanic, and traffic flow management operations. As part of the SkyLine-X team, you’ll contribute to mission-critical technology that supports the safety, efficiency, and modernization of air traffic operations around the world. In addition, the role will foster regional collaboration and innovation in aviation concepts, technologies, and implementations, ensuring alignment with customer needs, operational objectives, and long-term strategic goals.

Establishment And Setup

Work closely with end-user customers to understand their requirements and ensure the center meets their needs.

Team Leadership

Establish and implement processes, best practices, and standards for software development and project management.

Drive the accelerated delivery of system enhancements required for the operational system, ensuring it keeps abreast of technological advancements and new operational requirements.

jobs.description:
Project Manager – Technology Modernization Program

Position Summary

The Project Manager will lead one or more strategic initiatives within the Bank's multi-year Technology Modernization Program. This role is responsible for driving execution across business and technology workstreams, managing project plans, risks, dependencies, governance, and stakeholder communications while ensuring successful delivery of transformation objectives.

The Project Manager will work closely with business leaders, technology teams, implementation partners, and vendors to coordinate activities across solution design, integration, data conversion, testing, training, operational readiness, and deployment. Experience supporting large-scale banking transformations, core system replacements, or digital modernization efforts is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Develop and manage detailed project plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.
Drive execution across business, operations, technology, data, integration, and vendor workstreams.
Track progress against scope, schedule, budget, risks, and key deliverables.
Facilitate project governance, status reporting, and executive-level communications.
Ensure decisions, assumptions, action items, and dependencies are documented and actively managed.

Stakeholder Management

Partner with business leaders, application owners, technology teams, and external vendors.
Coordinate activities across multiple stakeholder groups to ensure alignment and timely decision-making.
Escalate risks, issues, and roadblocks appropriately while driving resolution.
Build strong working relationships across functional areas and organizational levels.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Identify and manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions and project impacts.
Support control readiness, operational readiness, and organizational preparedness activities.

Data & Integration Management

Lead data and integration workstreams across the modernization program, ensuring alignment between business requirements, target-state architecture, and implementation plans.
Coordinate activities related to data migration, data conversion, data validation, data governance, reconciliation, and reporting readiness.
Manage cross-system integration dependencies, including APIs, middleware, file-based interfaces, real-time messaging, and third-party vendor connectivity.
Partner with business, technology, architecture, and vendor teams to define, document, and track interface requirements, source-to-target mappings, and data flows.
Facilitate issue resolution related to data quality, data lineage, integration defects, and application interoperability.
Ensure integration and data deliverables are incorporated into project plans, testing cycles, cutover activities, and production readiness assessments.
Coordinate end-to-end testing activities supporting integrations, conversions, reporting, and downstream operational processes.
Monitor and manage risks associated with data dependencies, interface readiness, reconciliation accuracy, and conversion execution.

Vendor & Implementation Partner Coordination

Coordinate delivery activities with third-party vendors.
Monitor vendor commitments, delivery milestones, and dependency management.
Facilitate working sessions, workshops, design reviews, and status meetings.
Ensure alignment between vendor deliverables and business objectives.

Testing & Readiness

Support planning and coordination of SIT, UAT, dress rehearsals, and production readiness activities.
Partner with business and technology teams to ensure successful execution of testing and defect remediation.
Coordinate conversion, cutover, training, and go-live readiness activities.

Change & Communication

Partner with Change Management teams to support stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and adoption activities.
Ensure impacted teams understand upcoming changes, key dates, and required actions.

Qualifications

Required
Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, or related field.
5+ years of project management experience leading complex technology transformation, modernization, or enterprise change initiatives.
Demonstrated experience within Commercial Banking and Private Banking business domains, including lending, deposits, treasury services, payments, client onboarding, client servicing, and operational processes.
Strong understanding of enterprise data management, data migration, data governance, reporting, and analytics concepts.
Experience managing data conversion, system integration, and operational readiness activities for large-scale technology implementations.
Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional business, technology, operations, data, and vendor teams.
Strong experience with project planning, risk management, issue resolution, dependency management, and executive status reporting.
Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Experience working within structured Program Management and Governance frameworks.

Preferred

Experience leading banking, financial services, or fintech transformation programs.
Experience working with system integrators and third-party vendors.
PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent certification

Compensation

The expected annual salary for this position is between $145,000 and $165,000 at the start of employment. A salary offer is determined on an individualized basis, taking into consideration factors such as an individual’s skills and experience. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package also includes eligibility for an annual bonus, medical, pharmacy, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, employee wellness program, retirement and savings plans with employer contributions, generous holiday and paid time off schedules, parental leave, and tuition reimbursement.

Requirements And Preferences

The Broward County Board of County Commissioner's is seeking qualified candidates for an Information Technology Specialist (ITS) - Project Manager position in the E911 Section of Communications and Technology Division for Regional Emergency Services and Communications.

Benefits of Broward County Employment

Eleven (11) paid holidays each year

Vacation (Paid Time Off) = 2 weeks per year

Tuition Reimbursement (Up to 2K annually)

Up to 40 hours of Job Basis Leave for eligible positions

Paid Parental Leave

Health Benefits

High-Deductible Health Plan – bi-weekly premiums: Employee $10.90 / Family $80.79

Includes a County Funded Health Savings Account of up to $2000 Annually

Consumer Driven Health Plan – bi-weekly premiums: Employee $82.58 / Family $286.79

Florida Retirement System (FRS) – Pension or Investment Plan

457 Deferred Compensation County matches up to $2,000 a year

The E911 Section of the Communications and Technology Division is responsible for the implementation of lifecycle, strategic, and operational projects to enhance the overall call-handling process for over 1.3 million 911 and Text to 911 calls and over eight hundred thousand non-emergency calls annually by all Public Safety Answering Points (PSAP) in Broward County. The E911 section is committed to providing technology solutions to enhance the call processing environment and ongoing support for high availability associated with mission-critical systems at the PSAPs. We are excited about our direction and would like you to join our team.

*** This position does not offer a remote working option ***

General Description

Manages large scale information technology projects.

Works under administrative supervision, developing and implementing programs within organizational policies and reports major activities to executive level administrators through conferences and reports.

This position will provide project management leadership over key E911 technology projects and assist with project activities associated with Information Technology Programs within E911. The ITS - Project Manager will provide leadership in organizing, planning, and the execution of project management responsibilities for software integration, infrastructure, consulting services, and vendor integration projects. Project development and delivery require compliance with established project management processes to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, adhere to high quality standards to meet customer expectations.

This is a capital project funded position responsible for managing multiple projects within E911. This position will participate in all aspects of procurement (e.g. RFP, Bids, Contract Amendments, etc.) regarding the acquisition of hardware, software, consulting services, and professional services.

Minimum Education And Experience Requirements

Requires a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major coursework in computer science or closely related field.

(One year of relevant experience may be substituted for each year of required education.)

Requires four (4) years of experience in systems analysis, systems design and/or applications programming relevant to area of assignment including related project management or closely related experience.

Special Certifications and Licenses

Position requires the possession and maintenance of a valid Florida E Class Driver's License

Possession of or eligibility to obtain basic CJIS Security Awareness Level 4 certification.

Possession of a Project Management Professional or Certified associate in project management is a plus

Preferences

Masters Degree or Higher in Computer Science, MIS, CIS, Business, or closely related field

Experience managing cross functional large projects

IT Project management experience working closely with technical and end user staff

PMP, CAPM, and PgMP

Extensive experience with Vendor Integration Projects

Experience with executing the procurement process for the acquisition of hardware, software, and services.

Knowledge and experience with Voice and Data Networks

SCOPE OF WORK

Duties And Responsibilities

The functions listed below are those that represent the majority of the time spent working in this class. Management may assign additional functions related to the type of work of the job as necessary.

Provides high-level technical expertise and project management direction of multiple large scale information technology initiatives including technological research, analysis, design, development, and implementation of projects.

Reviews County-wide information technology strategic direction, recommends approaches for incorporation of the emerging technologies when appropriate, and implements the approved approach.

Reviews programming techniques and recommends information technology solutions, enhancement plans, and related cost-benefit comparisons.

Supervises professional and technical personnel in assigned work teams or sections.

Plans, organizes and implements approved emerging technologies.

Administers County-wide technological specialty functions.

Performs project management responsibilities for large scale complex information technology projects.

Reviews systems designs, development of applications, and documentation for accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to departmental standards.

Documentation of deployment, security, quality assurance, change controls, and compliance.

Ability to lead staff and vendor assigned resources to successfully deliver key capital IT projects.

Manages multiple cross-functional E911 projects of low to high complexity.

Develop project plans, direct, and monitor work efforts on a daily basis, identifying resource needs, performing quality and risk reviews, and proactively take mitigative steps to reduce the potential impacts of risks.

Serve as the single point of contact for all project management activities for assigned projects.

Serve as the liaison with the PSAP operations and E911 staff for training and acceptance testing related to assigned projects.

Provide Vendor Management to ensure that all vendors are meeting their project and contractual commitments.

Assist in facilitating PMO meetings and process improvement updates for E911.

Responsible for tracking key project milestones and adjusting project plans and/or resources to meet the needs of customers.

Coordinates and communicates with stakeholders at all levels.

Develop presentations to provide project updates to stakeholders at all levels of the organization

Must possess extensive knowledge and expertise in the use of project management methodologies (e.g. Waterfall) and tools

Must follow Change Management processes and procedures.

Performs related work as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Physical Demands

Physical demands refer to the requirements for physical exertion and coordination of limb and body movement.

Performs sedentary work that involves walking or standing some of the time and involves exerting up to 10 pounds of force on a regular and recurring basis or sustained keyboard operations.

Unavoidable Hazards (Work Environment)

Unavoidable hazards refer to the job conditions that may lead to injury or health hazards even though precautions have been taken.

None.

SPECIAL INFORMATION

Competencies

Tech Savvy: Anticipates and adopts innovations in business-building digital and technology applications. Is an early adopter of new technologies, technical skills, and capabilities that improve performance. Regularly experiments with and leverages technologies and tools to substantially improve performance.
Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Consistently looks at complex issues from many angles; obtains a rich and deep understanding; swiftly cuts to the core issue; skillfully separates root causes from symptoms.
Action Oriented: Takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. Takes immediate, decisive, independent action to resolve issues or problems. Persists as needed. Quickly and consistently identifies and pursues beneficial new opportunities.
Plans and Aligns: Plans and prioritizes work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals. Outlines clear plans that put actions in a logical sequence; conveys some time frames. Aligns own work with relevant workgroups. Takes some steps to reduce bottlenecks and speed up the work.
Optimizes Work Processes: Knows the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement. Pays close attention to a variety of metrics and benchmarks; determines both major and subtle ways to optimize processes. Swiftly resolves process breakdowns; takes steps to ensure that problems do not recur.
Courage: Steps up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. Shares own ideas and points of view openly, regardless of potential criticism or risk; shows conviction when faced with adversity and challenges; raises difficult topics to be sure they are addressed.
Self-Development: Actively seeks new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels. Demonstrates a strong commitment to development by regularly practicing and applying new knowledge and skills; is quick to share new learning with others. Creates a thorough, detailed development plan.

County Core Values

Instills trust: Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

Powering the cars of today and tomorrow. Reducing harmful emissions. Giving unique properties to high-end applications. Giving new life to used metals. As a global advanced materials and recycling group, we develop, produce, and recycle materials for a better life.

About Support Functions

A global organisation. It’s not just those in our industrial sites and technical centres that are vital to Umicore’s growth. Across our support functions we ensure that we continue to grow and evolve – whether it’s by making sure our decisions are commercially viable, enhancing our reputation, building new customer relationships or finding the right people who can build on what we’ve already achieved. The variety of our work means we cannot stand still. We need to find new ways to do things, discover new solutions and develop new ideas. Which is where you come in.

What You Will Be Doing

We are currently looking for an Enterprise Security Manager – Crisis and Resilience
to join our headquarters in Brussels. Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, in this role you will focus on specific security areas: Crisis and Resilience. You will be the project manager for security related initiatives on multi-site level to enhance operational excellence in these domains while promoting a security attitude for all and create awareness via the security community as an expert in security legislation across regions and countries.

Responsibilities

Lead the design and implementation of a global crisis management framework aligned with key security risks (geopolitical, hybrid threats, utilities and communication), ensuring business continuity and organisational resilience.
Drive intelligence gathering and analysis by synthesising geopolitical and security information from internal and external sources, translating insights into actionable briefings for senior leadership and security stakeholders.
Collect and consolidate existing crisis management practices across sites and functions to establish a harmonised baseline.
Define risk scope, assess potential impacts, and prioritise mitigation actions based on business criticality and evolving geopolitical context.
Establish and maintain crisis management methodologies, tools, and governance frameworks aligned with enterprise standards.
Prepare structured reporting and updates on crisis preparedness and resilience posture for the Security Committee.
Monitor and interpret relevant regulatory and legal developments, translating them into practical guidance for business stakeholders.
Raise awareness of compliance requirements and emerging risks across the organisation.
Design and deliver crisis and resilience training programmes, including workshops, seminars, and best practice sharing.
Support and implement a train‑the‑trainer approach to strengthen internal crisis response capabilities.
Evaluate organisational readiness through maturity assessments, tabletop exercises, and real-life crisis simulations at site level.
Lead and coordinate cross-functional crisis and resilience improvement projects across multiple sites and business units.
Act as key security contact for designated sites, ensuring alignment and supporting local crisis preparedness initiatives.
Provide ongoing operational and administrative support to crisis and security activities, maintaining continuity and knowledge backup.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

5+ years’ professional experience in crisis management, resilience, security, or a closely related field.
Master’s degree in a risk, security, or resilience‑related discipline, with additional certification such as ISO 31000.
Proven capability in intelligence gathering, analysis, and synthesis of complex information from multiple sources.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate insights into clear, structured reporting for senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience in risk assessment, preparedness, and resilience frameworks.
Exposure to a high‑tech or industrial manufacturing environment is an advantage.
Fluent in English (written and spoken); good knowledge of French and/or Dutch, German or any other languages are a plus.
High level of integrity, discretion, and professional judgement when handling sensitive information.
Convincing communicator with excellent written communication and presentation skills.
Strong organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Ability to build and maintain effective internal and external networks across regions and cultures.
Strategic mindset with the ability to anticipate risks and translate strategy into practical actions.
Pragmatic, solution‑oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Cost‑aware, balancing risk mitigation needs with operational and financial considerations

Your Key Accountabilities

Delivers expert work in Security with high quality and timeliness, applying best practices and standards.
Owns complex tasks in Risk Analysis, security operations management, producing accurate outputs and identifying risks or anomalies proactively.
Analyzes problems, recommends options, and implements improvements in methods, tools, or data flows.
Collaborates with adjacent teams and stakeholders, communicating insights and recommendations clearly.
Mentors less experienced colleagues, reviewing deliverables and elevating team standards.
Coordinates cross‑functional adoption of discipline‑specific enhancements ensuring consistent application and measurable performance gains.
Leads, develops and executes several security or privacy domains on a global scale or a regional (multi-country) responsibility on security.

Who we are looking for

for recruiting purposes only

What We Can Offer

We aim to lead the way. Not just for our customers, but for our employees too. That is why we strive to create a collaborative environment in which we can all succeed, and a culture through which we can all share ideas, develop our expertise and advance our careers. We engage in building an inclusive work culture that offers equal opportunities for all employees irrespective of their diverse backgrounds. As you would expect from a world-leading organisation, we will also reward your contribution with a competitive salary and benefits. With all this and more, imagine what you could do?

jobs.title: GRC Program Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Redefine the future of live entertainment tech

Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. Backed by over $65 million in funding, our platform empowers event organizers to own their brand experience, unlock deep data insights, and seamlessly integrate ticketing into their digital infrastructure.

With six offices worldwide and growing, we deliver a customizable, intuitive solution and industry-leading support that simplify even the most complex ticketing challenges – helping organizers deliver exceptional experiences and drive real growth.

Join us and build the future of live entertainment.

With over 10 million end users
and usage quadrupling annually, our infrastructure now handles over 1 billion requests per month
— and counting. Our API-first platform solves complex system challenges at scale — delivering performance, flexibility, and reliability for the world’s leading live entertainment brands.

As our GRC Program Manager
, you will be the driving force behind vivenu’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance execution. This is fundamentally an execution- and delivery-focused role: you are a true program manager who knows how to get things done yourself while driving cross-functional accountability across Engineering, Product, Legal, and Security teams.

You will lead our GRC initiatives end-to-end, driving audit strategy, owning internal risk workflows, and managing complex compliance projects across the organization. By translating regulatory and framework requirements into actionable, practical business processes, you will ensure vivenu continues to scale securely and responsibly across global markets without sacrificing developer velocity.

As a GRC Program Manager (d/f/m) your responsibilities will include:

Drive Program Execution & Ownership:
Take full end-to-end accountability for GRC deliverables, setting timelines, tracking cross-functional dependencies, and orchestrating teams to ensure compliance milestones are hit on schedule

Lead Internal Audit Operations:
Serve as the primary internal leader and project owner for third party audits (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, ). Own the process from scoping to successful completion, managing evidence collection, guiding control owners, and leading remediation efforts

Build & Scale Compliance Frameworks:
Maintain and mature robust compliance frameworks, ensuring continued preparation for evolving global requirements such as GDPR and related security standards

Manage Risk & Remediation Workflows:
Conduct practical IT, security, and third-party risk assessments. Maintain vivenu’s risk register, ensuring risk treatment plans and corrective actions are actively assigned, tracked, and closed out by control owners

Optimize GRC Operations & Tooling:
Leverage modern GRC platforms and automation tools to streamline audit tracking, policy administration, vendor risk management and issue remediation workflows

Enable Engineering & Product Teams:
Partner closely with technical teams to embed security controls, privacy-by-design, and cloud best practices directly into our development lifecycle and API-first platform

Support Enterprise Sales Readiness:
Assist in answering complex enterprise customer security questionnaires, supporting third-party risk reviews, and demonstrating vivenu's robust compliance posture during high-value sales engagements

Governance & Executive Reporting:
Translate complex technical and regulatory findings into clear risk posture dashboards, KRIs, and operational updates for leadership

What you will need to succeed in this role:

Execution & Program Management:
Proven track record of getting things done: driving cross-functional projects, aligning diverse technical and business stakeholders, and holding teams accountable to deliverables

Audit Leadership Experience:
Hands-on experience leading major compliance audits (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001) from start to finish as the internal counterpart and owner

Domain Context:
Prior experience in SaaS, Fintech, or cloud-native technology environments is highly preferred. If your background is from another sector, a strong curiosity and fast-learning mindset toward modern cloud, API, and SaaS architectures is required

GRC Experience
: demonstrated exposure to GRC and Security processes such as risk assessments, internal audits, policy development, corrective actions management

Framework Familiarity:
Solid working knowledge of core industry standards and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, GDPR, NIST CSF/RMF)

Communication & Influence:
Outstanding ability to translate regulatory requirements into clear operational steps, communicating effectively with both deep technical experts and business executives

Location:
Must be currently residing in and authorized to work in Germany

Languages:
Business fluency in English
is required.

Nice to have:

Technical Aptitude:
Basic hands-on technical familiarity (e.g., basic scripting, working with APIs, or reading system logs/configurations) is a big plus

Exposure to GRC automation tools (e.g., Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM, or LogicGate)

Relevant professional certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CISM, CISSP
, CSSP
or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor

German
language proficiency would be a plus.

Why join vivenu?

Live Entertainment Tech

Play a mission-critical role for global brands, redefining fan experiences from festivals to major sports events. Here, you’re part of the business of fun — powered by cutting-edge technology that brings moments to life for millions.

Sustainable Growth

We scale sustainably on a profitable, VC-backed foundation with true product-market fit. This means continuous investment in our people, products, and long-term vision.

Top-tier Team

Collaborate with over 160 dedicated professionals, including leaders from Google, Slack, and Salesforce. Together, we’re shaping the future of live entertainment technology, one decision at a time.

Global DNA

We’re a diverse, merit-driven team spread across six global offices. Talent and impact are what matter here — not hierarchy or background.

Fast Growing, in All Aspects

Sifted consistently ranks us among the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe. We’re driven by daily learning, shared wins, and collective growth.

Next-Gen Leaders & Insights

Work alongside some of tech’s brightest minds — from Forbes 30 Under 30 founders to Executive of the Year award winners. At vivenu, you’ll help set the standard for the ticketing industry’s future.

vivenu Inclusion Statement

At vivenu, we believe our people define our success – and that we win with bold, diverse minds. The strongest teams are built on different perspectives, experiences, and voices. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to contribute, grow, and thrive to shape the future of live entertainment globally.

Check out our mission statement and corporate values here.

jobs.title: IT Security Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
In Deiner Mission Blühst Du Auf, Denn

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den sicheren Betrieb der definierten Leistungen und stellst sicher, dass Anforderungen der IT- und Informationssicherheit wirksam umgesetzt und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.
Als zentrale Ansprechperson koordinierst du Themen rund um ISB/ISMS, Datenschutz sowie SOC/SIEM und arbeitest eng mit IT-Architektur, Security Management, CISO und IT-Management zusammen.
Du analysierst Sicherheitsmeldungen und Vorfälle, bewertest Risiken und leitest passende Maßnahmen zur Minimierung und Prävention ab.
Das Vulnerability Management liegt in deiner Hand: Du koordinierst und überwachst Patch-, Schwachstellen- und Lifecycle-Management und sorgst dafür, dass Sicherheitslücken sowie EOL-Themen rechtzeitig adressiert werden.
Darüber hinaus planst und führst du Audits, Security Risk Assessments und Business Impact Analysen durch, begleitest Penetrationstests und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen (z. B. NIS2) inklusive Dokumentation sicher.

Deine Skills? Mehr als interessant:

Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, IT-Sicherheit oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Informationssicherheit / IT-Security
Kenntnisse in ISMS (z. B. ISO 27001), Datenschutz und Security-Technologien (SOC/SIEM, Vulnerability Management)
Erfahrung mit Risikoanalysen, Audits, Business Impact Analysen und idealerweise Penetrationstests
Persönlich gefallen uns besonders analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, die Fähigkeit komplexe Themen verständlich aufzubereiten, Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit Stakeholdern bis auf Management-Level sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Du Verdienst Echten Mehrwert. Freu Dich Deshalb Auf

Weiterentwicklung: Mit einem umfangreichen Angebot der Bechtle Akademie, individueller Karriereplanung, Expert:innen- und Führungsprogrammen, Herstellerzertifizierungen und vielem mehr entwickelst du dich kontinuierlich weiter und bleibst niemals stehen.
Rund-um-Sorglos-Paket: Deine Zukunft ist uns wichtig. Das zeigt unsere attraktive Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung sowie unsere betriebliche Altersversorgung mit einer Bezuschussung von bis zu 100 Prozent.
30 Tage Urlaub: 6 Wochen freie Zeit, die du zur Erholung, Entspannung, zum Reisen und Füße hochlegen nutzen kannst.
Geschäftswagen: Profitiere von einem attraktiven und nachhaltigen Angebot an Fahrzeugen inklusive Tankkarte, die du auch privat nutzen kannst.
Onboarding: Unsere umfassende Einführungsveranstaltung MIKADO, ein individuell auf deine Rolle abgestimmter Schulungsplan und eine persönliche Ansprechperson sorgen für deinen perfekten Start bei uns.
Verantwortung: Von Beginn an kannst du in spannenden Projekten viel bewegen und dein volles Potenzial ausschöpfen.

Das erwartet dich im Bechtle IT-Systemhaus Bremen: An unseren Standorten in Bremen und Oldenburg arbeiten über 200 Kolleg:innen an den IT-Belangen unserer Kunden – von Server & Storage über Virtualisierung und IT Security bis hin zu Cloud-Lösungen. Bei uns triffst du auf ein motiviertes Team aus jungen Talenten und erfahrenen Expert:innen. Wir bieten dir moderne Büros mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung, kostenlose Getränke und Obst, regelmäßige Teamevents sowie attraktive Pausenbereiche – von der Dachterrasse in Bremen bis zur Eventküche in Oldenburg.
