jobs.title: DoW SkillBridge – Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

DoW SkillBridge – Business Analyst

Company:
JIRACOR LLC

Location:
Orlando, Florida

Work Arrangement:
On-Site

Program:
Department of War (DoW) SkillBridge

Industry:
Defense & Federal Contracting

Build Your Next Career in the Defense Industry

JIRACOR LLC is seeking a motivated transitioning service member to join our Orlando team as a Business Analyst through the DoW SkillBridge Program
.

This opportunity is designed to provide hands-on experience in the business operations of a growing defense contractor. The selected participant will work alongside JIRACOR Executive Management and functional teams supporting business operations, financial analysis, federal contracting, project management, market research, data analysis, process improvement, customer support, and strategic planning
.

This is not an observational internship. You will work on real business requirements, projects, reports, analyses, and initiatives that support JIRACOR's day-to-day operations and long-term growth.

About JIRACOR

JIRACOR LLC is an Orlando-based defense contractor supporting U.S. Government customers through engineering, training systems integration, manufacturing, lifecycle logistics, program management, and professional services.

Our team operates in a highly regulated and mission-focused environment where accurate information, disciplined processes, financial awareness, contract compliance, and effective decision-making are essential.

The SkillBridge Business Analyst will gain exposure to multiple areas of the company and develop an understanding of how a defense contractor manages its operations from opportunity identification through contract execution and customer delivery.

What You Will Do

The Business Analyst will support Executive Management and JIRACOR's business functions with activities that may include:

Business & Data Analysis

Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret business and operational data.
Develop Excel-based analyses, trackers, dashboards, and management reports.
Identify trends, variances, risks, and potential areas for improvement.
Transform business data into concise information that supports management decisions.
Assist with development and monitoring of company Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Analyze actual performance against business plans, budgets, schedules, and management objectives.
Develop charts, summaries, and executive-level presentations.
Perform ad hoc analysis requested by Executive Management.

Financial & Contract Performance Support

Assist with tracking contract revenue, costs, funding, invoicing, and financial performance.
Support analysis of contract budgets and expenditures.
Assist with labor-hour and cost tracking.
Analyze planned versus actual costs and identify significant variances.
Support contract and task-order financial reporting.
Assist with development of contract-level financial dashboards.
Support forecasting of revenue, backlog, workload, and cash-flow requirements.
Assist management with evaluating the financial impact of business decisions.
Coordinate with accounting, contracts, program management, and other functional personnel to validate business data.

Contracts & Federal Business Operations

Review contracts, task orders, Statements of Work (SOWs), Performance Work Statements (PWSs), and other business documents.
Assist with identifying contract deliverables, reporting requirements, milestones, and due dates.
Develop and maintain contract trackers and action-item logs.
Support tracking of contract modifications, funding actions, options, and periods of performance.
Assist with contract compliance documentation and internal reviews.
Research applicable federal contracting requirements and business processes.
Gain practical exposure to IDIQ contracts, task orders, GSA schedules, subcontracting, and federal acquisition processes.

Project & Program Support

Assist Program and Project Managers with schedules, milestones, deliverables, risks, and action items.
Develop and maintain project trackers and management dashboards.
Support Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and project schedule updates.
Track project progress against established milestones.
Assist with risk and issue tracking.
Support preparation of internal and customer-facing status reports.
Participate in project meetings and document decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.
Follow up on outstanding actions and support management visibility into project status.

Business Process Improvement

Review existing business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and accuracy.
Document current and future-state business processes.
Develop process maps, workflows, checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures.
Identify repetitive or manual processes that may benefit from automation.
Assist with standardizing company reporting and data collection.
Support implementation of business tools and improved workflows.
Assist with internal quality and process-improvement initiatives.

Market & Business Research

Conduct research on government agencies, defense programs, industry trends, competitors, customers, and potential partners.
Research federal opportunities using government and commercial information sources.
Analyze historical contract information and government spending data.
Monitor relevant RFIs, Sources Sought notices, solicitations, contract awards, and agency forecasts.
Prepare concise research summaries and business intelligence reports for management.
Assist with maintaining the company's business opportunity pipeline.
Support preparation of company capability information and customer presentations.

Reporting & Executive Management Support

Prepare recurring and ad hoc management reports.
Assist with quarterly and annual business reviews.
Develop PowerPoint presentations and briefing materials for Executive Management.
Consolidate information from multiple departments into executive-level reports.
Track organizational goals, initiatives, commitments, and action items.
Conduct research and analysis to support strategic business decisions.
Assist with preparation for customer, partner, banking, and other external business meetings.
Maintain organized records supporting management decisions and business initiatives.

CRM, SharePoint & Information Management

Maintain accurate information within company CRM and internal databases.
Maintain customer, partner, supplier, and business contact information.
Assist with SharePoint organization and document control.
Maintain proper file naming, document organization, and version control.
Support development and maintenance of company business databases and trackers.
Assist with improving data quality and consistency across business systems.

Proposal & Business Growth Support

Assist with reviewing government requests for information and solicitations.
Develop requirements and compliance matrices.
Support preparation of business and technical information for proposals.
Assist with proposal schedules, document organization, graphics, and supporting data.
Research customers, competitors, incumbent contractors, and potential teaming partners.
Support preparation of customer and partner capability briefings.
Assist with industry day, conference, and customer meeting preparation.

What You Will Gain

This SkillBridge opportunity provides exposure to the full business lifecycle of a defense contractor, including:

Business Analysis & Decision Support
— Learn how organizations turn financial, contractual, operational, and market information into management decisions.

Financial & Contract Analysis
— Gain practical experience analyzing revenue, costs, labor, budgets, contract funding, and performance.

Federal Contracting
— Understand how federal contracts, IDIQs, task orders, solicitations, modifications, and deliverables are managed.

Project Management
— Develop experience with schedules, milestones, risks, deliverables, reporting, and project controls.

Data Analytics & Reporting
— Build dashboards, trackers, KPIs, reports, and executive-level presentations.

Process Improvement
— Learn how to analyze workflows, identify inefficiencies, document processes, and implement improvements.

Strategic & Market Analysis
— Research government customers, markets, competitors, contracts, and emerging business opportunities.

Executive-Level Exposure
— Work directly with company leadership and learn how business, financial, contractual, and operational information influences executive decisions.

Who We Are Looking For

We are interested in transitioning service members who have demonstrated analytical ability, accountability, initiative, and the ability to solve problems.

Military experience in the following areas can translate particularly well to this position:

Operations
Logistics
Intelligence
Finance or resource management
Acquisition or contracting
Program or project management
Maintenance management
Supply chain
Engineering
Training
Communications
Administration
Planning
Data analysis
Staff operations

Prior Defense-industry Or Federal Business Experience Is Not Required.

We value military experience involving planning, briefing leadership, analyzing information, tracking resources, managing programs, developing reports, coordinating organizations, solving problems, and executing against deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree completed or in progress, or equivalent combination of military education and relevant experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
Proficiency with Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.
Ability to analyze data and communicate findings clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
Interest in business operations, finance, federal contracting, project management, data analytics, or the defense industry.

Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required
:

Microsoft SharePoint
Microsoft Power BI
Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems
Project scheduling tools
SAM.gov
FPDS or federal spending data
GSA contract vehicles
Deltek GovWin IQ
Federal acquisition or contracting
Government program management
Process improvement methodologies

SkillBridge Eligibility

Applicants must meet applicable DoW SkillBridge eligibility requirements
and obtain authorization from their military chain of command before participation.

SkillBridge participation is subject to Service member eligibility, command approval, and applicable DoW and Military Department requirements.

Citizenship & Security Requirements

Due to the nature of JIRACOR's U.S. Government contracts, U.S. citizenship is required
.

Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance at the appropriate level when required by JIRACOR contracts or programs.

An active DoD security clearance is a plus.

Work Location

JIRACOR LLC – Orlando, Florida

This is an on-site position and is not remote
.

The SkillBridge participant will work directly with JIRACOR Executive Management and collaborate with personnel supporting contracts, finance, accounting, program management, engineering, operations, quality, and business development.

Why JIRACOR?

Your military experience has already developed many of the skills businesses need: leadership, accountability, analytical thinking, planning, communication, resource management, adaptability, and mission execution
.

At JIRACOR, you will have the opportunity to translate those capabilities into practical business experience while learning how a defense contractor operates, competes, executes contracts, manages programs, and supports U.S. Government customers.

Your military mission may be ending. Your next one is just beginning.

Join JIRACOR

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics
, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics
, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?

Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

Sufficient understanding of SSIS and SSAS to support accurate migration and documentation

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, GO-AI Technology & Development Team
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Robotics (AR) is at the forefront of applying state-of-the-art artificial intelligence to solve real-world challenges at unprecedented scale. Our fulfilment centers handle more individual items than any company in the world, combining computer vision, mobile robots, advanced end-of-arm tooling, high-degree-of-freedom movement, and state-of-the-art AI. We collaborate with teams across Amazon worldwide to conceive, develop, prototype, and deploy intelligent robotic systems that push the boundaries of industrial automation.

Within Amazon Robotics, the Global Operations – Artificial Intelligence (GO-AI) organization enables Amazon to accelerate and scale the next generation of AI-powered robotic solutions. We're transforming how complex visual reasoning tasks are performed across Amazon's robotics operations, moving from traditional manual data annotation processes to state-of-the-art foundation model solutions. GO-AI's Technology & Development team is a cross-functional organization of Software Development Engineers, Technical Program Managers, Program Managers, and Business Intelligence Engineers responsible for GO-AI's technical strategy, platform capabilities, and delivery.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on GO-AI's Technology & Development team, you will partner with product, science, software engineering, data engineering, operations, and other Amazon Robotics teams to accelerate the evaluation, deployment, and scaling of AI solutions across Amazon Robotics. You will own complex, cross-functional programs spanning solution definition, experimentation, operational readiness, deployment, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires balancing technical depth with strong program ownership.

This is a rare opportunity to work with a team building AI systems that operate at Amazon scale while solving novel technical challenges in computer vision, natural language processing, and human-AI collaboration. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, engineers, and operations teams to deploy state-of-the-art research into production systems that deliver real-world impact at global scale.

Key job responsibilities

Partner with other Amazon teams to understand AI automation-based use cases, evaluate partnership opportunities, and define GO-AI's technical and operational plans to support them.
Build trusted partnerships with business and technical teams, serving as the primary GO-AI partner throughout the program lifecycle.
Design and lead human-in-the-loop solutions and AI workflows that bridge science, engineering, and operations.
Partner with GO-AI Software, Science, Data, and Business Intelligence Engineering teams to identify capability gaps, prioritize features, and influence long-term platform roadmaps.
Define success metrics, monitor program health, and use data to drive decisions, identify risks, and evaluate trade-offs.
Drive senior leadership reviews through clear written and verbal communication of program strategy, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.
Drive process simplification by eliminating inefficiencies and building scalable mechanisms.

A day in the life

About The Team

Within Amazon Robotics, the Global Operations - Artificial Intelligence (GO-AI) team enables Amazon to accelerate and scale the next generation of AI-powered robotic solutions. We're transforming how complex visual reasoning tasks are performed across Amazon's robotics operations, moving from traditional manual data annotation processes to state-of-the-art foundation model solutions.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
Experience defining technical requirements and partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable technical solutions.
Demonstrated ability to drive clarity and define program structure in ambiguous domains.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with computer vision, human-in-the-loop systems, or model evaluation and deployment.
Experience influencing product or platform roadmaps across multiple engineering teams.
Track record of coaching and mentoring other Technical Program Managers.

jobs.description:
Job Title: AI Program Manager

Location: Beaverton, OR

Duration: 03 months

Pay Range: $(64.78 – 68.14)/hr on W2 all-inclusive without benefits

Job Description:

Location and/or time zone and expected work schedule: WHQ M-F biz hrs
Team details & who they will work with
: This role operates within Global Sales while working extensively across Global Tech, Business Intelligence, Supply Chain, Brand, Legal, AI Governance, Enterprise AI, and other partners.
Working within an established Global Sales AI strategy, this role sustains momentum and delivery during a period of leave coverage, with a primary focus on leading the day-to-day operations of the Sales AI Lab and keeping cross-functional partners aligned as the program matures.

Desired candidate profile:

Minimum required years of experience: 10+ years
Education requirements: No

Top must-have skills include the following:

Program Mgt skills- launched Sales AI Lab, coordinate and drive the tool
Communication is key- all stakeholders, communicate daily with VPs and executive levels
Understand the dynamics of AI- impact to biz, read and react to dynamics between AI and biz

Nice to have skills:

Build using Cursor, Co pilot, CoWork tools
Familiar with Claude Cowork

Software/technical requirements:

Using AI tools, looking for people that are enthusiastic about these tools, able to run without a technical background!
Previous client/industry experience preference: Helpful

Additional Information

What 2-3 traits does the successful person in the role have? Team player(interact with so may people to drive AI adaption), passionate, high energy for AI, self starter, no playbook for this role as it’s new, work with ambiguity, not task orientated, drive the agenda

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking an experienced program leader to provide coverage for the Principal, Global Sales AI during an approximately three-month leave.
The AI strategy and operating direction are already defined and in motion; this role is responsible for driving execution, most notably leading the newly launched Sales AI Lab, which will still be in its early stages.
The successful candidate will keep the Lab’s operational cadence running, help define and align the business cases that emerge from it, and maintain continuity across stakeholders and initiatives so the program does not lose momentum during the coverage period.
This role works with significant autonomy, solving ambiguous and novel problems through independent judgment while operating within existing strategy and governance frameworks.
It requires strong program management, credibility with senior stakeholders, and the ability to keep cross-functional work moving without direct authority.

Key skills, experience, and qualifications include:

10+ years of experience in strategy, digital transformation, data, technology, or enterprise program leadership Proven ability to lead large-scale, cross-functional initiatives without direct authority
Strong fluency in AI concepts, data foundations, and responsible governance applied in a business context
Demonstrated program and operating-cadence management, running recurring forums, intake, and reporting rhythms
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to executive and non-technical audiences
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, experience, and training

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:

This role operates within Global Sales while working extensively across Global Tech, Business Intelligence, Supply Chain, Brand, Legal, AI Governance, Enterprise AI, and other partners.
Working within an established Global Sales AI strategy, this role sustains momentum and delivery during a period of leave coverage, with a primary focus on leading the day-to-day operations of the Sales AI Lab and keeping cross-functional partners aligned as the program matures.

What You Will Work On:

You will lead the operational delivery of the Global Sales AI agenda during the coverage period, with the Sales AI Lab as your primary focus.
You will operate at the intersection of enablement, governance, and execution, keeping the Lab running, advancing the initiatives already underway, and ensuring AI continues to deliver value across Sales.

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, and completion of projects considering budget, timelines, resources, and task management. You will communicate transparently and in a timely manner with assigned Signant Health clients and internal stakeholders, managing project risks and ensuring timely resolution while reporting status with appropriate internal and external stakeholders. This role requires an effective leader who excels in problem-solving, can motivate a result-oriented team, and builds trust-based relationships with Signant Health clients. You will contribute to the implementation of company-wide process improvements to ensure effective and efficient project delivery.

Key Accountabilities

Manage and lead initial project delivery tasks, including the software development lifecycle (SDLC) of simple to medium complexity studies.
Ensure project systems are built and released in accordance with client expectations; lead the project system change control process.
Support implementation of complex, multi-product projects as needed.
Manage projects in accordance with established timelines, budgets, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
Review, approve, and maintain project and corporate systems and documentation.
Handle client escalations independently; work with internal and client teams to resolve issues and escalate as appropriate in a timely manner.
Serve as the primary contact for customers on assigned projects; ensure quality of communication with clients in terms of cadence, content, and audience.
Manage financial health of assigned projects, including vendor services, licensing, payments, invoicing, devices, resource assignments, and vendor management activities.
Collaborate with other functional areas to ensure project delivery meets timelines and client expectations within budget.
Identify and document Incident Reports with Quality Management; coordinate client notification and closure.
Report project status updates to internal and external stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
Proven experience in a Project Management role or equivalent
Understanding of the software development life cycle and specification and configuration of software products
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with excellent time management, communication (oral and written), and organizational skills
Detail-oriented with focus on first-time quality delivery
Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint)
Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization; comfortable presenting to diverse and large audiences
Proven ability to direct project activities, ensure customer satisfaction, and adhere to study budgets
Must show initiative and be able to work independently as needed

Desirable:

Background in pharmaceutical, medical device, medical education, or CRO industries
Experience with clinical trials, pharmaceutical industry, or life sciences
Knowledge of the clinical research environment and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) principles
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
Willingness to travel for business (overnight trips expected quarterly)

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. new_jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

Legal and Compliance manages all legal and regulatory matters, including privacy, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, employment law, intellectual property, government relations, and claims, while supporting Coursera's and Udemy's platforms and partnerships. The Privacy Program Manager is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the company's global privacy program across products, platforms, and business functions. Working closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, this role translates privacy and data protection requirements into scalable operational processes, governance, and technical controls that embed privacy by design across the organization. The role owns core privacy operations, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, vendor privacy reviews, and data subject rights requests, while driving automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement to enable the business to meet privacy obligations efficiently at scale.

Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Procurement, and other stakeholders to conduct privacy reviews for new products, features, vendors, and business initiatives, embedding privacy by design into business processes.
Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) and a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), or equivalent privacy certification.

Nice to haves:

Experience working in a technology, software-as-a-service (SaaS), or online education environment.
Experience supporting privacy programs for artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning products.
Experience supporting compliance with additional global privacy laws, including APAC and Latin American privacy frameworks.
Experience defining and reporting operational metrics, KPIs, or dashboards for privacy programs.
Law degree or equivalent legal training.

Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring base salary range for this role in Canada is CAD 78,400 to CAD 98,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Keep Learning

If this opportunity interests you, you might like these courses on Coursera:

Privacy Law and Data Protection

Data Privacy, Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance

The Senior Talent Acquisition Program Manager drives strategic hiring initiatives that strengthen Empower’s ability to attract exceptional talent within a hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A and 503B environment. This role owns end-to-end execution of enterprise Talent Acquisition programs, including Early Careers, Always-On Pipelining, Competitive Hiring, and strategic initiatives, ensuring projects remain aligned, visible, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is measured through operational and program-delivery metrics—milestone adherence, execution quality, and stakeholder satisfaction—rather than recruiting-volume metrics. Leveraging AI as a force multiplier, the position accelerates planning, reporting, decision-making, knowledge management, and operational efficiency while maintaining quality, compliance, and candidate experience. Success requires Talent Acquisition expertise, disciplined project management, exceptional stakeholder partnership, and continuous improvement. This opportunity is designed for P80–P90 talent demonstrating strategic thinking, execution rigor, learning agility, and unwavering accountability for delivering scalable recruiting programs that create sustainable organizational impact.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership

Program Ownership: Own end-to-end planning and execution of strategic Talent Acquisition programs, such as early careers, proactive pipelining, competitive intelligence, and other prioritized initiatives. Develop comprehensive project plans, manage milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables while leveraging AI-enabled planning, documentation, and reporting tools to improve execution speed, stakeholder visibility, decision quality, and overall program performance across multiple concurrent workstreams supporting business growth.
Strategic Execution: Translate Talent Acquisition priorities into structured project roadmaps by defining objectives, timelines, success metrics, governance, and resource requirements. Balance competing priorities while proactively identifying risks, resolving issues, and utilizing AI-generated insights to strengthen planning accuracy, optimize resource allocation, improve execution consistency, and ensure projects deliver measurable business value aligned with organizational objectives and hiring strategies.
Risk Management: Establish disciplined project governance by monitoring progress, identifying emerging risks, escalating issues appropriately, and implementing mitigation strategies before challenges impact hiring outcomes. Utilize AI-assisted reporting, predictive analysis, and operational dashboards to improve visibility, support informed decision-making, strengthen accountability, and ensure strategic Talent Acquisition programs remain on schedule, within scope, and positioned for long-term success.

Talent Acquisition Expertise

Recruiting Partnership: Partner closely with recruiters, sourcers, Talent Acquisition leaders, and hiring managers to translate recruiting strategies into executable project plans that improve hiring outcomes. Apply practical expertise in sourcing, funnel management, candidate experience, employer branding, and workforce planning while leveraging AI tools to enhance planning, collaboration, documentation, and operational effectiveness without replacing sound recruiting judgment.
Pipeline Strategy: Support strategic hiring programs by understanding the unique objectives, timelines, and success measures associated with campus recruiting, evergreen talent pipelines, and competitive hiring initiatives. Monitor funnel health, identify substantive recruiting risks beyond project schedules, leverage AI-driven insights to recognize trends, and recommend corrective actions that strengthen pipeline quality and hiring effectiveness.
Program Excellence: Develop repeatable operating models, implementation plans, and recruiting playbooks that enable Talent Acquisition programs to scale consistently across business functions. Capture lessons learned, standardize best practices, and use AI-supported knowledge management to improve documentation quality, accelerate onboarding, preserve institutional knowledge, and continuously enhance execution across future hiring initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the central point of coordination across Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, Marketing, business leaders, universities, vendors, and external partners to maintain alignment, resolve dependencies, and ensure seamless execution. Facilitate productive discussions using structured communication, AI-assisted meeting preparation, and transparent reporting that builds trust, strengthens collaboration, and drives successful project outcomes.
Executive Communication: Deliver concise, data-driven updates that provide leaders with clear visibility into project health, hiring progress, program risks, and recommended actions. Develop executive-ready dashboards, presentations, and status reports enhanced through AI-generated analysis while ensuring messaging remains accurate, actionable, compliant, and aligned with organizational priorities and strategic workforce objectives.
Event Coordination: Coordinate recruiting events, career fairs, campus engagement activities, hiring campaigns, and cross-functional initiatives that strengthen employer branding and talent attraction efforts. Manage logistics, communications, stakeholder readiness, and execution plans while utilizing AI to streamline planning activities, improve scheduling efficiency, enhance candidate experiences, and maximize program effectiveness throughout each recruiting cycle.

Operational Excellence

Performance Analytics: Measure and communicate program effectiveness through meaningful recruiting metrics, dashboards, and business insights including pipeline health, conversion rates, hiring velocity, and program outcomes. Leverage AI-powered analytics to identify trends, forecast opportunities, uncover operational improvement areas, and equip leaders with actionable recommendations that strengthen recruiting performance and strategic decision-making.
Process Improvement: Evaluate Talent Acquisition workflows to identify inefficiencies, eliminate unnecessary complexity, standardize operating procedures, and improve execution quality across recruiting programs. Apply structured continuous improvement methodologies supported by AI-enabled workflow analysis to enhance scalability, reduce manual effort, improve stakeholder experiences, and create sustainable operational excellence supporting organizational growth.
Vendor Evaluation: Support periodic evaluation and selection of Talent Acquisition vendors, tools, and platforms as program needs evolve, preparing recommendations for leadership review; this role does not hold budget ownership, and hands-on guidance for vendor analysis and selection will be provided as needed.
Continuous Learning: Maintain awareness of emerging Talent Acquisition practices, project management methodologies, AI capabilities, and industry trends that strengthen organizational performance. Champion innovation through thoughtful experimentation, continuous learning, and disciplined implementation while balancing business agility with governance, compliance, and long-term operational sustainability in a rapidly evolving hiring environment.

Knowledge And Skills

Demonstrated knowledge of Talent Acquisition operations, including recruiting lifecycle management, sourcing strategies, pipeline development, candidate experience, hiring metrics, workforce planning, and recruiting program execution.
Strong project management capabilities with experience developing project plans, managing timelines, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, mitigating risks, and delivering complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
Proficiency using project management platforms, applicant tracking systems, Microsoft 365 applications, reporting tools, dashboards, and AI-enabled productivity solutions to improve planning, communication, documentation, and decision-making.
Exceptional analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to synthesize data, influence without authority, solve complex operational challenges, and drive continuous improvement.

Experience And Qualifications

Minimum of 5+ years of combined experience in Talent Acquisition including both full-cycle recruiting and program or project management with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level Talent Acquisition programs and cross-functional initiatives.
Practical understanding of recruiting fundamentals, including sourcing strategies, funnel management, candidate experience, pipeline development, hiring stages, and recruiting seasonality.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects while coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, communicating project status, mitigating risks, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

Experience supporting candidate attraction, campus recruiting, evergreen hiring programs, competitive hiring initiatives, or large-scale recruiting campaigns is preferred.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role:

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high-intensity, high-visibility execution role involving the creation of net-new data-driven, AI- and ML-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.

The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.

This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations.

What You’ll Be Doing In This Role

Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect & adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas
Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement
Leading end-to-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform-specific workflows
Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor
Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization
Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream
Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year-on-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures

What You Bring

5-8 years of project management experience
Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard
A self-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told
Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal
Experience in technology-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution
Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools
Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities to improve team productivity and decision-making
Strong RAID discipline, schedule management, budget oversight, and the instinct to track details without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Comfortable managing multiple workstreams concurrently in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus
North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.

This position has a starting salary range of $75,000 – $90,000 USD / 75,000 – 123,000 CAD
per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.
We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.
We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.
We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.
We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact careers@jdpower.com for accommodation request.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. The Project Manager will lead one or more strategic initiatives within the Bank's multi-year Technology Modernization Program. The Project Manager will work closely with business leaders, technology teams, implementation partners, and vendors to coordinate activities across solution design, integration, data conversion, testing, training, operational readiness, and deployment. Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Develop and manage detailed project plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.
Drive execution across business, operations, technology, data, integration, and vendor workstreams.
Track progress against scope, schedule, budget, risks, and key deliverables.
Facilitate project governance, status reporting, and executive-level communications.
Ensure decisions, assumptions, action items, and dependencies are documented and actively managed.

Coordinate activities across multiple stakeholder groups to ensure alignment and timely decision-making.
Escalate risks, issues, and roadblocks appropriately while driving resolution.
Build strong working relationships across functional areas and organizational levels.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions and project impacts.
Support control readiness, operational readiness, and organizational preparedness activities.

Data & Integration Management

Facilitate working sessions, workshops, design reviews, and status meetings.

Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Experience working within structured Program Management and Governance frameworks.

Experience working with system integrators and third-party vendors.

We scale sustainably on a profitable, VC-backed foundation with true product-market fit. This means continuous investment in our people, products, and long-term vision.

The Pratt & Whitney Government Security Compliance (GSC) cybersecurity team is seeking an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to support our team in East Hartford, Connecticut. Current DoD 8570 IAM Level II certification (Security+, CGRC, CISM) with the ability to acquire IAM Level III certification (GSLC, CISSP, CISSM, or other) within 6 months
Active US Government Security Clearance, SECRET level or higher.

Experience with information system security and monitoring tools (i.e. Splunk, Symantec, Ivanti, Tenable, ACAS, HBSS, etc.)

Familiarity with large multi-facility networks including various complex components, including Windows and Linux environments

Leads the delivery of physical security systems by managing implementation, coordinating teams, and ensuring compliance with specifications, timelines, and quality standards.
Demonstrates expertise in the delivery and integration of physical security technologies, including closed-circuit television (CCTV) systems, electronic access control systems, intrusion detection alarms, and perimeter security solutions.

Responsible for identifying, qualifying, and quantifying construction-related risks, and communicating those risks clearly and effectively to the stakeholders in written form to support proactive planning and resolution.
Collaborates in design reviews to support accurate and comprehensive field documentation across project teams.
Demonstrated proficiency in developing schedules, establishing project baselines, and identifying, qualifying, and quantifying deviations, with clear communication of impacts to the client.

Project Manager

Bogotá

El rol del Project Manager
consiste en planificar, ejecutar y finalizar proyectos de acuerdo con plazos estrictos y dentro del presupuesto establecido. El Project Manager es responsable de la gestión diaria de la ejecución del proyecto, lo que incluye la asignación de recursos y la coordinación de los esfuerzos de los miembros del equipo para entregar los proyectos de acuerdo con el plan establecido. Asimismo, definirá los objetivos del proyecto y supervisará el control de calidad durante todo su ciclo de vida.

Responsabilidades:

Gestionar a los miembros del equipo del proyecto e influir en ellos para promover acciones positivas y responsabilidad sobre sus tareas.
Gestionar el proyecto y sus procesos, incluida la definición y el monitoreo continuo del Documento de Implementación del Proyecto (PID).
Ejecutar y alinear el alcance, los objetivos, los hitos detallados y los entregables del proyecto en colaboración con la alta dirección y las partes interesadas.
Elaborar el Plan de Implementación del Proyecto.
Elaborar y gestionar el Plan del Proyecto, de Calidad y de Comunicaciones.
Definir el plan de recursos.
Representar las necesidades del Equipo de Implementación durante la etapa de preventa.
Llevar a cabo la planificación y gestión de recursos.
Gestionar y escalar los riesgos y problemas del proyecto.
Gestionar el presupuesto del proyecto.
Garantizar que los miembros del equipo conozcan y cumplan todos los procedimientos y políticas pertinentes.
Gestionar de manera proactiva los cambios en el alcance del proyecto durante toda su ejecución.
Garantizar una comunicación adecuada entre los miembros del equipo del proyecto e informar a las partes interesadas sobre el avance y cualquier otra información específica relevante.
Liderar las actividades de traspaso a soporte después de la salida a producción (go-live).
Liderar las actividades de lecciones aprendidas durante todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto.
Elaborar el Informe de Cierre del Proyecto.

Calificaciones

Requisitos esenciales

Experiencia en gestión de proyectos, implementando soluciones ERP integradas para el sector salud con múltiples líneas de trabajo, en un rol de contacto directo con clientes.
Experiencia en el ciclo de vida completo de proyectos, desde la iniciación y ejecución hasta la salida a producción (go-live) y el cierre.
Se prefiere ampliamente conocimiento directo del sector salud y/o más de 3 años de experiencia con sistemas de TI para salud.
Experiencia en gestión de recursos, seguimiento de horas, presupuestos y proyecciones.
Experiencia liderando equipos diversos y multidisciplinarios.
Experiencia comunicándose eficazmente con personas de todos los niveles de una organización.

Deseable

Conocimiento de los procedimientos hospitalarios y/o empresariales, prácticas de trabajo habituales, estructura y dinámica organizacional.
Experiencia previa como usuario final de un sistema integrado de salud.
Experiencia o formación clínica y/o de negocios, idealmente como usuario de TrakCare u otras aplicaciones de Sistemas de Información Hospitalaria (HIS).
Experiencia en implementaciones integradas.
Conocimiento general de los aspectos técnicos relacionados con la implementación y entrega de soluciones de TI.

Educación y formación

Título universitario o más de 5 años de experiencia gestionando proyectos grandes y complejos, preferentemente en TI para el sector salud.
Conocimientos técnicos de software y procesos de implementación.
Certificación o formación en gestión de proyectos, como PRINCE2, PMP o PMI.
Formación en gestión a nivel senior.
Certificación PMI deseable.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

adMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines.

Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking.

Our award-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike.

The Role

As a Technical Project Manager at adMarketplace, you'll be the driving force that turns complex, multi-team technical initiatives into shipped outcomes — owning the plan, the timeline, and the follow-through for our key strategic advertiser partnerships integrations end-to-end. This is a founding, builder function: you'll translate ambiguous technical and business asks into structured workstreams, keep Partnerships, Product, and Engineering aligned and moving, and make sure nothing that matters falls through the cracks.

You'll need real technical depth to do this well — this is not a purely administrative coordination role. You should be comfortable getting hands-on with APIs, data feeds, and attribution infrastructure so you can plan the work credibly, spot risk early, and push back when a timeline or scope doesn't hold up.

Technical Discovery & Planning

Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise clients; document, prioritize, and sequence based on business impact (ROI)
Build and own the integration plan for client-specific solution architectures — scoping, sequencing, and tracking delivery against milestones, and adapting the plan as partner requirements evolve without losing continuity on existing commitments
Own client-specific POC planning and execution specifically for joint technical projects spanning AMP and partner engineering/product teams — coordinating across technical and business stakeholders to keep scope and timeline on track
Drive Build vs. Configure decisions to resolution; make recommendations and escalate where required
Track data accuracy and reconciliation workstreams between internal and partner-reported data sets, making credible interim calls where full visibility isn't available and revisiting them as better data arrives — ensuring open items are owned and closed out

Partner Integration & Delivery

Own the project plan for technical onboarding of new demand integrations — feed setup, attribution API integration, bid automation configuration, and credential provisioning — sequencing dependencies and unblocking stalled work
Serve as the primary point of accountability for keeping client-side technical issues moving to resolution
Produce and maintain the actual content within that system for each partner — specs, project plans, status trackers, and open-question logs — ensuring every initiative has an accurate, current record owners can reference directly
Monitor partner technical channels and route escalations internally with appropriate urgency, tracking through to closure
Support integration of oRTB-based third-party demand partners and new vertical feed categories, including ticketing and travel

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with the Account team, Product, Engineering, and Supply-side Solutions Engineer to drive integrated solutions — running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned
Coordinate publisher feasibility assessments with Supply Solutions Engineer
Build and run the recurring reporting rhythm and governance structure for key strategic advertiser partnerships’ technical initiatives as a founding function — a single tracking system covering initiative status, ownership, dependencies, and open items, kept current through a regular cadence rather than reconstructed ad hoc for each meeting or report
Serve as the primary voice of project status in client-facing meetings alongside the Account team
Translate client-specific technical requirements into actionable, sequenced inputs for engineering and product
Represent progress and risk in internal reviews, launch planning, and go-to-market readiness
Support billing methodology discussions by tracking and translating technical attribution data into commercial inputs for Partnerships and Finance.

Technical / Functional Skills

Hands-on experience with oRTB, APIs (REST/JSON), product feed management, event tracking, and attribution infrastructure
SQL proficiency required, or demonstrated ability to work closely with data/analytics teams to validate and interpret technical data
Experience with retail media ecosystems and advertiser measurement workflows — attribution modeling, ROAS optimization, smart bidding, and data pipeline infrastructure — strongly preferred

Core Competencies

Proven track record driving complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects from ambiguous ask to shipped outcome
Structured project/program management: scoping, sequencing, risk tracking, and status reporting
Client-facing technical discovery and the ability to translate business requirements into engineering-ready, sequenced work
Comfort with requirement gathering, live troubleshooting, and presenting to mixed technical and non-technical audiences
Experience operating within a RACI-structured, cross-functional environment— including partner organizations with layered or shifting stakeholders, where knowing who actually needs to be looped in changes as roles and ownership evolve
Genuine comfort with ambiguity — building process from scratch and holding the team to it

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years in technical program/project management, solutions engineering, technical partnerships, or integration engineering — ideally within ad tech, retail media, or programmatic advertising
Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end delivery on technical, cross-functional initiatives, not just individual workstreams
Bachelor's degree required; technical field preferred

Compensation:
$160,000 - $180,000 + bonus + equity

Join Us

adMarketplace has been named as one of the best places to work in New York City by Built In and Crain’s- the latter of which have recognized us the past three years straight! AMP is currently experiencing triple digit growth, and it’s never been a better time to join our team!
We offer a robust continuing education program, management training, regular company-wide lunch and learns, and well-defined career paths to ensure all our employees have an opportunity to grow.

At adMarketplace, we play to win, but we learn from our setbacks. Our commitment to a collaborative environment means no one succeeds alone, and no one fails alone either.
We know you’ve come to expect comprehensive healthcare, wellness programs, paid time off, commuter benefits, and 401k matching from any company, so it’s a good thing we offer all of that and so much more. adMarketplace offers Summer Fridays, catered lunches, a fully stocked kitchen, ZogSports teams, happy hours and corporate retreats to encourage a strong work/life balance.

No Third Party Recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Press Ganey is the leading experience measurement, data analytics, and insights provider for complex industries—a status we earned over decades of deep partnership with clients to help them understand and meet the needs of their key stakeholders. Our earliest roots are in U.S. healthcare –perhaps the most complex of all industries. Today we serve clients around the globe in every industry to help them improve the Human Experiences at the heart of their business. We serve our clients through an unparalleled offering that combines technology, data, and expertise to enable them to pinpoint and prioritize opportunities, accelerate improvement efforts and build lifetime loyalty among their customers and employees.

Like all great companies, our success is a function of our people and our culture. Our employees have world-class talent, a collaborative work ethic, and a passion for the work that have earned us trusted advisor status among the world’s most recognized brands. As a member of the team, you will help us create value for our clients, you will make us better through your contribution to the work and your voice in the process. Ours is a path of learning and continuous improvement; team efforts chart the course for corporate success.

Our Mission

We empower organizations to deliver the best experiences. With industry expertise and technology, we turn data into insights that drive innovation and action.

Our Values

To put Human Experience at the heart of organizations so every person can be seen and understood.

Energize the customer relationship: Our clients are our partners. We make their goals our own, working side by side to turn challenges into solutions.
Success starts with me: Personal ownership fuels collective success. We each play our part and empower our teammates to do the same.
Commit to learning: Every win is a springboard. Every hurdle is a lesson. We use each experience as an opportunity to grow.
Dare to innovate: We challenge the status quo with creativity and innovation as our true north.
Better together: We check our egos at the door. We work together, so we win together.

Press Ganey is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or disabled veterans in the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation to apply for a position online or for your interviews or assessments, please contact us at acommodations@pressganey.com Please provide your contact information and the details of your request so we can best assist you.

The Client Implementation Manager will serve as the primary point of contact for clients and will coordinate all activities throughout the client’s onboarding experience. Following a post-sales handoff, the Implementation Manager will own the implementation process through the go-live phase and handoff to the Delivery Teams. Implementation Manager’s serve an important role for setting clients up for success by partnering with key stakeholders to facilitate full alignment on project expectations including product needs, timelines, and implementation strategy. The high-level goal of the role is to instill client confidence and trust from day one through clear communication of product needs and timelines, and by keeping all parties (internal and external) accountable to deadlines to ensure a successful implementation.

Implementations are highly custom and involve large data sets, which require the Client Implementation Manager to act as a liaison between the various teams, both internal as well as external. The right candidate for this role will embody entrepreneurial thinking, take an analytical and strategic approach to each client engagement and the role itself, and will be a master of using good judgment and thinking on their feet. The Implementation Manager should feel confident and comfortable explaining and conceptualizing how our various solutions work with a variety of unique client business needs. The role also requires an expert level of understanding in how hospitals and health systems function, the roles, and motivations of different parties within such clients and will learn how to navigate these complex organizations to ensure maximum alignment and client satisfaction.

This is a Hybrid role in any of the following locations: Chicago, South Bend or Provo, UT

Duties And Responsibilities

Provides day to day oversight of the client implementation including understanding the clients’ goals and use cases, recommend, and guide product configuration, help set expectations, and establish priorities.
Forms strong relationships with clients by serving as the primary point of contact for implementation, understanding and communicating client feedback internally.
Partners with Delivery Team to ensure completion of product configuration, manage timeline for deliverables and to setup clients for success.
Collaborate between multiple departments and teams to reconcile competing priorities to maximize overall client satisfaction and project success.
Brings in appropriate PGForsta experts and creates seamless handoff to other departments and post implementation support.
Identify and escalate challenges and risks associated with implementation and client satisfaction to supervisor and other senior team members before problems become critical.
Provides product overview and connects client with training and education opportunities.

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years’ of relevant experience in a client-facing project management, consulting, or operations role; ideally in a healthcare related field.
Excellent interpersonal, communications, listening, and presentation skills.
Solid working knowledge of improvement methodology, best practices, and data analytics
Proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects and attaining high client satisfaction.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while prioritizing competing client needs.
Obsession with customer experience including follow-up and problem resolution.

Education

Bachelor’s degree and 5 years minimum of prior relevant experience in a client-facing project management, consulting, or operations role; ideally in a healthcare related field.

Don’t meet every single requirement?
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Press Ganey we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Additional Information For US Based Jobs

to support a multinational technology client. This role will work closely with the client's intelligence team to provide real-time threat monitoring, intelligence collection, analysis, and reporting as a part of a 24/7/365 global security operations team. The analyst will monitor open-source intelligence, social media, client-specific intelligence platforms, and internal reporting streams to identify risks to personnel, executives, facilities, assets, operations, and reputation. Particular emphasis will be placed on monitoring violence, threats of violence, protests, activism, civil unrest, negative sentiment, and other negative alerts relating to the client. The role will also support executive monitoring activities, with a focus on the CEO's movements, travel, public appearances, and overall safety.

This role will cover the weekend Swing Shift. It will be a 4x10 schedule covering Monday-Friday 11:00 am-9:00 pm. This position will help cover 24/7/365 operations, and will require working weekends and holidays. Please confirm you are able to work this shift.

Conduct continuous monitoring of open-source intelligence, social media platforms, and client-specific intelligence tools for known and emerging threats to employees, executives, assets, facilities, operations, and reputation.
Monitor and assess violence, threats of violence, protests, activism, civil unrest, negative sentiment, and reputational threats that may impact the client.
Support executive monitoring efforts focused on the CEO's travel, movements, public engagements, and safety.
Monitor global events and identify developments that may affect company personnel, operations, facilities, events, and executive travel, including protests, transportation disruptions, political instability, terrorism, crime, and natural disasters.
Draft concise, tactical intelligence products including alerts, situation reports, executive monitoring updates, incident summaries, and threat assessments for distribution to security leadership and client decision-makers.
Maintain situational awareness during ongoing incidents by tracking developments and providing timely updates to stakeholders.
Support intelligence production through research, information gathering, and collaborative analysis efforts.
Partner with global security stakeholders to validate emerging threats and support risk mitigation activities.
Deliver written and verbal briefings to security leadership and operational stakeholders as required.
Collaborate across shifts to ensure continuous intelligence coverage and effective handovers in a 24/7/365 GSOC environment.
