new_jobs.description:
Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join the Market & Industries team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on several of IDC's vertical industry-focused Spending Guide data products , developing industry, company size, use case, and line of business forecasts across a broad range of technology markets. You will be responsible for conducting comprehensive industry sector research, mapping tech buyer use cases, analyzing data, and providing actionable insights to support our clients' business strategies. Having familiarity with or expertise in the overall ICT, software, and cloud technology markets in North America and globally will be advantageous for this role. The ideal candidate has a proactive mindset, strong quantitative, data modelling, and analytical skills, as well as the ability to use automation tools to improve and streamline internal data processes . He or she should demonstrate the ability to interpret complex data, identify patterns, and draw meaningful insights by evaluating data from various sources, making sense of quantitative and qualitative information, and providing actionable recommendations. We’re looking for an innovative thinker with a passion for data and technology trends. Based in Mexico City , this role offers flexibility with access to our vibrant IDC office and hybrid work.

What You’ll Do

Analyze survey data and conduct secondary market research on selected industry sectors - financial services, manufacturing, telecommunications, energy, healthcare, and public sector - along with technology solutions and geography specific trends to build a deeper understanding of the key factors shaping overall markets and technology adoption patterns.
Develop industry sector forecasts and predictive models by utilizing statistical methods and tools to anticipate future trends and tech buyer behavior.
Monitor key macroeconomic indicators such as GDP, inflation rates, unemployment rates, interest rates, and exchange rates and assessing its potential impact on various industry sectors.
Maintain and update databases with relevant market data and research findings, ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of all program deliverables.
Assess the impact of fiscal and monetary policies on industry sectors and technology adoption trends.
Prepare detailed reports and presentations to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop customized vendor and market models. Including the consulting team to support custom projects when required.

What You Bring

Minimum 3 years of quantitative and qualitative market research or market intelligence experience, ideally in the technology industry or in consulting.
Bachelor's or MA/MSc degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business, Economics, or STEM subjects (i.e., Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics), with a strong understanding of economic principles and their application to market analysis.
Critical and strategic thinking skills, with an understanding of the broader business implications of data findings.
Skilled in analyzing complex datasets and developing predictive models, with familiarity in statistical tools and methodologies. Proven experience in financial analysis and market modelling.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data analysis and report preparation.
Strong English written and verbal communication skills to effectively present research findings.
Efficient in managing multiple research projects and meeting deadlines. A strong team player with excellent problem-solving skills.
Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint skills required. Power BI skills, and ability to use Python or data analysis are an advantage.
Familiarity with the use of GenAI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, or Gemini in a business environment.
The position is hybrid, prevalently remote, working with colleagues across different regions, with occasional travel required.

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

Turn GIS and data into better decisions, smarter workflows, and stronger emergency response.

The Boise Fire Department is seeking a GIS Data Analyst to help transform operational and dispatch data into actionable insights that improve how the department works and serves the community. This mid-level role will leverage the Esri platform, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Field Maps, and ArcGIS Survey123 Connect, to develop, maintain, analyze, and improve GIS-based data and workflows across the department.

Working closely with personnel throughout the organization and supporting command staff, this position will analyze dispatch and operational data, identify trends and opportunities, improve business processes, and develop innovative GIS and data solutions. The GIS Data Analyst will look for ways to automate repetitive tasks, streamline workflows, improve data quality and accessibility, and build sustainable solutions that increase efficiency over time.

This is an opportunity for a GIS professional who wants to go beyond mapping—to solve operational problems, connect people and data, automate processes, and help leadership make informed, strategic decisions. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on Esri experience, analytical thinking, curiosity, and a proactive approach to finding ways technology and data can make the Boise Fire Department more effective.

Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We’re looking for a data-driven problem-solver with proven success investigating and identifying patterns in a highly analytical role in the consumer credit or lending industry, and solid familiarity with data analysis tools to join our Customer Operations team as a Principal Business Analyst, Fraud.

The Impact You’ll Make In This Role

You’ll drive forward our mission of empowering people to unlock financial progress by protecting our customers and our business from financial crime, reducing fraud losses, and improving the experience for our cardholders.

You will be instrumental in building and implementing application fraud defense strategies that balance risk and a seamless customer experience. This role is a fantastic opportunity to gain end-to-end knowledge and practical experience in critical, high-impact risk strategies, positioning you as a trusted expert in the rapidly evolving fintech space.

As a Principal Business Analyst, You Will

Analyze and Investigate Fraud Trends: Dive deep into application data to proactively identify emerging fraud patterns, uncover system vulnerabilities, and understand the evolving tactics used by criminals.
Develop and Fine Tune Fraud Strategies: Design, build, and implement new, real-time defenses to detect and prevent fraudulent applications. You will constantly test and refine our strategies to stay ahead of fraudsters.
Balance Risk with Customer Experience: Make thoughtful, data-backed decisions that strike the optimal balance between risk prevention and customer experience.
Monitor and Report on Performance: Create and maintain robust dashboards to track the performance of fraud strategies. You’ll be responsible for reporting on key metrics like coverage, pause rates, step-up completion rates, defense performance, and losses.
Optimize and Collaborate: Work closely with our Operations, Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to continuously improve fraud detection capabilities and strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

3+ years of experience in a highly analytical role (e.g., risk, business analytics, data science).
Experience conducting analytical work with credit cards or other consumer lending products.
Hands-on experience designing and executing A/B or Champion/Challenger testing within application or risk funnels.
Proven ability to problem solve end-to-end: from framing the question and forming a hypothesis, to analyzing the data, to communicating and debating the answer with stakeholders.
Familiarity with SQL, Python, or other tools for data analysis.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field with a record of strong academic performance.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience in Fraud Strategy and Analytics.
Expertise in SQL and Python.
Experience helping scale a business in a fast-paced startup environment.

Compensation

Why You Will Love This Position

The Fraud and Noncompliance Unit promotes a safe, supportive, fair, and equitable work environment by preserving the integrity of Missouri’s Workers’ Compensation system. The Division of Workers’ Compensation offers a dynamic, energetic and engaging environment in which to flourish and demonstrate operational excellence. The Division is modernizing its internal and external processes and procedures, and there is an immense opportunity to contribute to an exciting, forward-thinking, fast-moving, collaborative environment. What You Will Do

Direct, plan, and analyze daily operations of the Fraud and Noncompliance Unit.
Conduct fraud and noncompliance investigations and provide guidance and assistance to other investigators preparing for and investigating allegations of fraud and noncompliance, under the Workers’ Compensation Law.
Develop impactful performance metrics and management plans, conduct performance evaluations and analyze data in order to proactively identify areas for improvement.
Actively participate in forward-thinking modernization discussions and champion modernization efforts within the Fraud and Noncompliance Unit and across the Division.
Represent the Fraud and Noncompliance Unit at various governmental, civic and labor functions and provide educational and informational presentations explaining statutory and regulatory requirements in regard to the Workers’ Compensation Law.
Review written investigation reports for clarity, accuracy, investigative sufficiency, and timeliness.
Recommend investigations for referral to the Office of the Attorney General for possible prosecution.

Qualifications

All you need for success:

8 years of progressive experience conducting formal investigations, workers' compensation claims, or forensic financial auditing, with at least 2 years in a direct supervisory or managerial capacity ORa Bachelor’s degree in an applicable field of study such as Criminal Justice, Criminology, Psychology, Public Administration, Business Administration, or Pre-law and 4 years of relevant experience

Lack of post-secondary education will not be used as the sole basis for denying consideration to any applicant.

Desired Attributes

Possess strong leadership and management skills
Ability to manage change, provide program management, and achieve results
Attention to detail
Experience conducting fraud and noncompliance investigations, specifically relating to the workers' compensation industry
Expert knowledge of workers' compensation statutes and regulations
Relevant professional designation(s) such as Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Insurance Fraud Investigator (CIFI), Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Associate in Claims (AIC), Associate in Risk Management (ARM), etc.
Ability to utilize technology to facilitate process improvements and enhance efficiencies
Comprehensive knowledge of the procedural requirements and differences of administrative, criminal, and civil cases
Comprehensive knowledge of investigative techniques and procedures to include interviewing, evidence collection and preservation, and documentation of case information
Ability to review and/or prepare and present investigation reports, expert testimony and evidence to prosecutors, administrative review boards, grand juries, and court officials
Comprehensive knowledge of current investigative issues and theories.

In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive automation adoption, and deliver measurable business impact. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and operational scalability through automation and AI-enabled solutions.

Drive end-to-end execution of automation and process improvement programs supporting Books Risk Management workflows.
Communicate program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders across multiple organizations.
Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and automation opportunities to improve risk detection, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. new_jobs.title: DoW SkillBridge – Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Description

DoW SkillBridge – Business Analyst

Company:
JIRACOR LLC

Location:
Orlando, Florida

Work Arrangement:
On-Site

Program:
Department of War (DoW) SkillBridge

Industry:
Defense & Federal Contracting

Build Your Next Career in the Defense Industry

JIRACOR LLC is seeking a motivated transitioning service member to join our Orlando team as a Business Analyst through the DoW SkillBridge Program
.

This opportunity is designed to provide hands-on experience in the business operations of a growing defense contractor. The selected participant will work alongside JIRACOR Executive Management and functional teams supporting business operations, financial analysis, federal contracting, project management, market research, data analysis, process improvement, customer support, and strategic planning
.

This is not an observational internship. You will work on real business requirements, projects, reports, analyses, and initiatives that support JIRACOR's day-to-day operations and long-term growth.

About JIRACOR

JIRACOR LLC is an Orlando-based defense contractor supporting U.S. Government customers through engineering, training systems integration, manufacturing, lifecycle logistics, program management, and professional services.

Our team operates in a highly regulated and mission-focused environment where accurate information, disciplined processes, financial awareness, contract compliance, and effective decision-making are essential.

The SkillBridge Business Analyst will gain exposure to multiple areas of the company and develop an understanding of how a defense contractor manages its operations from opportunity identification through contract execution and customer delivery.

What You Will Do

The Business Analyst will support Executive Management and JIRACOR's business functions with activities that may include:

Business & Data Analysis

Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret business and operational data.
Develop Excel-based analyses, trackers, dashboards, and management reports.
Identify trends, variances, risks, and potential areas for improvement.
Transform business data into concise information that supports management decisions.
Assist with development and monitoring of company Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Analyze actual performance against business plans, budgets, schedules, and management objectives.
Develop charts, summaries, and executive-level presentations.
Perform ad hoc analysis requested by Executive Management.

Financial & Contract Performance Support

Assist with tracking contract revenue, costs, funding, invoicing, and financial performance.
Support analysis of contract budgets and expenditures.
Assist with labor-hour and cost tracking.
Analyze planned versus actual costs and identify significant variances.
Support contract and task-order financial reporting.
Assist with development of contract-level financial dashboards.
Support forecasting of revenue, backlog, workload, and cash-flow requirements.
Assist management with evaluating the financial impact of business decisions.
Coordinate with accounting, contracts, program management, and other functional personnel to validate business data.

Contracts & Federal Business Operations

Review contracts, task orders, Statements of Work (SOWs), Performance Work Statements (PWSs), and other business documents.
Assist with identifying contract deliverables, reporting requirements, milestones, and due dates.
Develop and maintain contract trackers and action-item logs.
Support tracking of contract modifications, funding actions, options, and periods of performance.
Assist with contract compliance documentation and internal reviews.
Research applicable federal contracting requirements and business processes.
Gain practical exposure to IDIQ contracts, task orders, GSA schedules, subcontracting, and federal acquisition processes.

Project & Program Support

Assist Program and Project Managers with schedules, milestones, deliverables, risks, and action items.
Develop and maintain project trackers and management dashboards.
Support Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and project schedule updates.
Track project progress against established milestones.
Assist with risk and issue tracking.
Support preparation of internal and customer-facing status reports.
Participate in project meetings and document decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.
Follow up on outstanding actions and support management visibility into project status.

Business Process Improvement

Review existing business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and accuracy.
Document current and future-state business processes.
Develop process maps, workflows, checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures.
Identify repetitive or manual processes that may benefit from automation.
Assist with standardizing company reporting and data collection.
Support implementation of business tools and improved workflows.
Assist with internal quality and process-improvement initiatives.

Market & Business Research

Conduct research on government agencies, defense programs, industry trends, competitors, customers, and potential partners.
Research federal opportunities using government and commercial information sources.
Analyze historical contract information and government spending data.
Monitor relevant RFIs, Sources Sought notices, solicitations, contract awards, and agency forecasts.
Prepare concise research summaries and business intelligence reports for management.
Assist with maintaining the company's business opportunity pipeline.
Support preparation of company capability information and customer presentations.

Reporting & Executive Management Support

Prepare recurring and ad hoc management reports.
Assist with quarterly and annual business reviews.
Develop PowerPoint presentations and briefing materials for Executive Management.
Consolidate information from multiple departments into executive-level reports.
Track organizational goals, initiatives, commitments, and action items.
Conduct research and analysis to support strategic business decisions.
Assist with preparation for customer, partner, banking, and other external business meetings.
Maintain organized records supporting management decisions and business initiatives.

CRM, SharePoint & Information Management

Maintain accurate information within company CRM and internal databases.
Maintain customer, partner, supplier, and business contact information.
Assist with SharePoint organization and document control.
Maintain proper file naming, document organization, and version control.
Support development and maintenance of company business databases and trackers.
Assist with improving data quality and consistency across business systems.

Proposal & Business Growth Support

Assist with reviewing government requests for information and solicitations.
Develop requirements and compliance matrices.
Support preparation of business and technical information for proposals.
Assist with proposal schedules, document organization, graphics, and supporting data.
Research customers, competitors, incumbent contractors, and potential teaming partners.
Support preparation of customer and partner capability briefings.
Assist with industry day, conference, and customer meeting preparation.

What You Will Gain

This SkillBridge opportunity provides exposure to the full business lifecycle of a defense contractor, including:

Business Analysis & Decision Support
— Learn how organizations turn financial, contractual, operational, and market information into management decisions.

Financial & Contract Analysis
— Gain practical experience analyzing revenue, costs, labor, budgets, contract funding, and performance.

Federal Contracting
— Understand how federal contracts, IDIQs, task orders, solicitations, modifications, and deliverables are managed.

Project Management
— Develop experience with schedules, milestones, risks, deliverables, reporting, and project controls.

Data Analytics & Reporting
— Build dashboards, trackers, KPIs, reports, and executive-level presentations.

Process Improvement
— Learn how to analyze workflows, identify inefficiencies, document processes, and implement improvements.

Strategic & Market Analysis
— Research government customers, markets, competitors, contracts, and emerging business opportunities.

Executive-Level Exposure
— Work directly with company leadership and learn how business, financial, contractual, and operational information influences executive decisions.

Who We Are Looking For

We are interested in transitioning service members who have demonstrated analytical ability, accountability, initiative, and the ability to solve problems.

Military experience in the following areas can translate particularly well to this position:

Operations
Logistics
Intelligence
Finance or resource management
Acquisition or contracting
Program or project management
Maintenance management
Supply chain
Engineering
Training
Communications
Administration
Planning
Data analysis
Staff operations

Prior Defense-industry Or Federal Business Experience Is Not Required.

We value military experience involving planning, briefing leadership, analyzing information, tracking resources, managing programs, developing reports, coordinating organizations, solving problems, and executing against deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree completed or in progress, or equivalent combination of military education and relevant experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
Proficiency with Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.
Ability to analyze data and communicate findings clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
Interest in business operations, finance, federal contracting, project management, data analytics, or the defense industry.

Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required
:

Microsoft SharePoint
Microsoft Power BI
Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems
Project scheduling tools
SAM.gov
FPDS or federal spending data
GSA contract vehicles
Deltek GovWin IQ
Federal acquisition or contracting
Government program management
Process improvement methodologies

SkillBridge Eligibility

Applicants must meet applicable DoW SkillBridge eligibility requirements
and obtain authorization from their military chain of command before participation.

SkillBridge participation is subject to Service member eligibility, command approval, and applicable DoW and Military Department requirements.

Citizenship & Security Requirements

Due to the nature of JIRACOR's U.S. Government contracts, U.S. citizenship is required
.

Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance at the appropriate level when required by JIRACOR contracts or programs.

An active DoD security clearance is a plus.

Work Location

JIRACOR LLC – Orlando, Florida

This is an on-site position and is not remote
.

The SkillBridge participant will work directly with JIRACOR Executive Management and collaborate with personnel supporting contracts, finance, accounting, program management, engineering, operations, quality, and business development.

Why JIRACOR?

Your military experience has already developed many of the skills businesses need: leadership, accountability, analytical thinking, planning, communication, resource management, adaptability, and mission execution
.

At JIRACOR, you will have the opportunity to translate those capabilities into practical business experience while learning how a defense contractor operates, competes, executes contracts, manages programs, and supports U.S. Government customers.

Your military mission may be ending. Your next one is just beginning.

Join JIRACOR

new_jobs.description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics
, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics
, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?

Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Customer Lifecycle Analytics: Analyse onboarding, activation, retention and lifecycle campaigns, helping local teams improve customer engagement and long-term revenue quality.
Performance Marketing Analytics: Analyse paid and organic acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, audiences and markets, helping teams understand where growth is efficient and where optimisation is needed.
Experimentation & Incrementality: Support the design, measurement and interpretation of marketing experiments, including A/B tests, landing-page tests, lifecycle tests and channel tests.
Cross-functional Connectivity: Bridge insights across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, ensuring a unified view of customer acquisition, value creation and retention.

📍 Job located in Paris, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You

Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Growth Analytics or Revenue Analytics, ideally in a SaaS, fintech, subscription, marketplace or digital product environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with dbt (modelling, testing, and documentation).
Business & Revenue Analytics Expertise: Strong understanding of revenue metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback), customer lifecycle and funnel analytics and commercial KPI frameworks. Marketing analytics experience is a strong plus.
Analytical Breadth: Comfortable working across forecasting, LTV modelling, funnel analysis, and operational KPI frameworks.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English. German is strongly preferred for the German market scope; Spanish would be beneficial for the Spain market scope.
Nice to have: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Hightouch, Census, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Saghar (Analytics Manager) + a technical SQL assessment.

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Position Overview
:
The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst will support discovery, documentation, migration coordination, test readiness, stakeholder engagement, and migration tracking activities across the CRDM (Credit Risk Data Mart) migration lifecycle for migration from on-prem SQL Server to Snowflake, including ETL, semantic model, reporting, and downstream consumer migrations. This will be a lift and shift migration. This role bridges business stakeholders, analytics teams, data consumers, and technical delivery teams to ensure assets, dependencies, reports, and consumer systems are accurately identified, documented, validated, and transitioned.

Role and Responsibilities:

Responsible for identifying opportunities for improving Data and Business Intelligence Solutions.
Data subject-matter expertise, or proven ability to identify and collaborate with the appropriate data SMEs. Works on complex projects/teams independently and acts as a mentor and lead to other Analysts.
Create user stories and write acceptance criteria.
Create and maintain inventories of database tables, views, attributes, stored procedures, code, SSIS packages, SSAS cubes, dimensions, measures, reports, reporting dependencies, and downstream consumer systems such as SAS, Moody’s, and internal applications.
Partner with business users to identify actively used data assets, reports, queries, and opportunities to retire unused assets.
Develop and maintain data dictionaries, source-to-target mappings (STTM), data lineage, and dependency documentation.
Serve as a lead for Data Q&A – Perform functional testing and data validation and liaison between business, developers, and other technical teams to coordinate UAT planning, execution, defect tracking, business signoff, report validation, migration readiness, and consumer system migration activities.
Track inventories, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and status throughout the migration lifecycle, including EDP (Enterprise Data Platform) adoption work to repoint CRDM-sourced EDW objects to corresponding EDP objects.
Establish processes and automation for the enterprise-grade Data & BI platform.
Ensure the Security, Governance, Enterprise Architecture guidance and protocols are adhered.
Communicate progress, risks, and issues to the project team .

Functional requirements documents (BRD) – with business requirements, dashboards and views, calculated measures, algorithmic inputs, SLAs, etc.
Source to Target mapping documents
Technical specifications documents (TSD) – with architecture, data dictionary definitions, data model specifications, wireframes, computations/formulae for calculated measures, etc.
Test strategy, test plan and test cases for testing and data validation
Create data testing/validation scripts/Alteryx workflows
Produce operational support documentation (and runbooks with dev team’s help)
Produce release notes/documentation
Create documentation for change control
Provide end-user adoption support
Other project documentation and artifacts as defined and assigned by Project Manager or Data & BI leadership

SQL and other relational database concepts and languages required
PowerBI
SQL Server Management Studio
Azure Synapse
Advanced Excel, Word and PowerPoint

About Us

This is your chance to kickstart your career at HarrisX, at HarrisX, a leading technology, market research, and consulting company that blends corporate and public opinion research to uncover what drives people, brands, and policy. We specialize in understanding the connected consumer, running some of the most comprehensive studies on technology, telecom, and media behavior globally, while also serving as one of the most accurate pollsters in recent U.S. elections.

Our research combines quantitative and qualitative methods, behavioral data, and social analytics to deliver actionable insights to clients ranging from Fortune 100 corporations to media organizations, advocacy groups, and policymakers. Based in Washington DC and with offices in New York, Toronto, London, Los Angeles, Australia, and Singapore, HarrisX is a member of Stagwell Global.

Our mission is simple: To connect all the dots for our clients, in what we call “Connected Intelligence.”

Overview

As a Research Analyst on the Custom Research team at HarrisX, you will support end-to-end research engagements across corporate, media, and public opinion research projects. Working under the direction of a Research Manager, you will contribute to research design, build and program surveys, analyze data, and help develop client-ready deliverables.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suited for someone early in their research career who is eager to develop technical depth across quantitative and qualitative methods. You will work as part of a collaborative project team alongside Research Managers, Directors, VPs, data scientists, and research operations team, contributing to studies that inform both corporate strategy and public narratives.

HarrisX offers strong growth opportunities for motivated analysts who are looking to build skills quickly and take on greater responsibility over time.

Responsibilities

Support the planning and execution of custom research projects, including timeline tracking, fieldwork coordination, and vendor management under the direction of a Research Manager.
Assist in the development of research instruments, including survey questionnaires and moderator guides, in line with established methodological standards.
Program surveys using platforms such as Decipher, Qualtrics, or ConfirmIT, and manage quality checks throughout the fieldwork process.
Clean, process, and analyze survey data using Q, SPSS, or equivalent statistical tools, applying appropriate weighting and validation techniques.
Contribute to the preparation of reports, presentations, and dashboards that translate findings into clear, actionable insights for client delivery.
Support the integration of multiple data sources, including survey, behavioral, and secondary data, as directed by senior team members.
Participate in client communications, documenting business objectives and project requirements under the guidance of a Research Manager or Director.
Collaborate cross-functionally with analysts, data scientists, and research operations colleagues across project workstreams.
Apply and develop familiarity with AI-powered tools used for survey automation, data synthesis, and content analysis as part of the team's evolving workflow.

Qualifications

You have 1–2 years of experience in custom market research, data analysis, or a related research environment.
You have academic and practical exposure to a range of research methodologies, including new product, brand, advertising, and customer satisfaction research.
You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, and have working knowledge of Q, SPSS, SAS, or equivalent statistical software. Experience with R, Python, or data visualization tools is a plus.
You have hands-on experience programming surveys in platforms such as Decipher, Qualtrics, or ConfirmIT.
You understand survey methodology fundamentals, including best practices for questionnaire design, statistical weighting, and data validation.
You are comfortable working with multiple data types and have a foundation in data cleaning, analysis, and visualization.
You communicate clearly in both written and verbal form, and can present findings in a structured, accessible way.
You are detail-oriented, able to manage competing priorities under tight deadlines, and comfortable operating with some ambiguity.
You are curious about AI-powered tools and open to applying them within research workflows, including survey automation and data synthesis.
You hold a Bachelor's degree, preferably in economics, statistics, mathematics, political science, communications, or a related field. A Master's or advanced degree is a plus.

HarrisX is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
